title: Sr. Manufacturing Engineer, Trainium Manufacturing, Quality and Reliability
descriptionHtml:
Within Amazon, Annapurna Labs team is building the next generation cloud server infrastructure. Our success depends on delivering world-class server infrastructure; we're handling massive scale and rapid integration of emergent technologies. Our servers include accelerators such as AWS Inferentia and AWS Trainium which are machine learning products designed to deliver high performance at low cost.

The Trainium Manufacturing, Quality and Reliability Team is part of Amazon Annapurna Labs focused on Machine Learning products that designs cutting AI platforms for the world’s largest Cloud Services provider. We are seeking a talented and motivated Sr. Manufacturing Engineer with a proven track record of implementing best in class test techniques and processes within a complex supply chain in Asia. As a member of the Cloud-Scale Machine Learning Acceleration team, you will be the interface between the system engineering team and the ODM and CM partners in Asia.
As a Sr. Manufacturing Engineer you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to conceive and design infrastructure technologies. You will work closely with an internal inter-disciplinary team, and outside partners to drive key aspects of product definition, execution and test in manufacturing.

The successful candidate will be capable of making wide-ranging business decisions on behalf of the organization and willing to “roll up sleeves and do what needs to get done” to consistently deliver results. We’re changing an industry, and we want individuals who are ready for this challenge.

* Be responsible for the test validation of future technologies.
* Drive manufacturing process improvements to address reliability issues and concerns.
* Qualify manufacturing lines and mechanisms for mass production
Lead identifying and validating product/component risks and work with design teams to mitigate them and define the test methodology and test coverage to assure product quality
* Provide technical leadership and mentor engineers.
* Working with multiple vendors and ODMs to standardize component manufacturing and reliability expectations.


Key job responsibilities
- Work with system engineering teams to identify and escalate manufacturing challenges by enforcing DFM, DFA and DFS principles
- Evaluate, investigate and introduce new manufacturing technology and methodology to enhance product quality and production efficiency at ODM and CM
- Develop or adapt manufacturing process at the ODM and CM, including defining fixture requirements, critical assembly requirements, test methodology, signal integrity, power and heat management requirement
- Drive all factory-related operational issues related to assembly processes during pre-production builds; ensure effective closure to enable operational success of the new product introduction cycle, and put products into mass production
- Manage product lifecycle changes, lead product quality and reliability improvement projects, and drive technical root cause for supplier defects
- Implement and optimize manufacturing 1st pass yields and efficiency from prototype through product ramp
- Work with engineering teams in US to clearly represent process and reviews to enable smooth New Product Introduction and changes
- Support cost reduction and sustaining activities
- travel to CM, JDM, ODM site

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Annapurna Labs
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or 5+ years of electrical or mechanical engineering experience
- Experience using common electronics test equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, function generators, etc)
- 5+ years of designing experiments and statistical analysis of results experience
- Experience in process design and documentation
- 6+ years of root cause analysis and process design experience
- Experience in working with external and internal partners throughout development and production
- Experience in printed circuit boards (PCB) assembly, including solder paste, chip mounting, reflow soldering, advanced cold plate assembly.
- Experience in PCB inspection and meteorology including optical, Lasers, X-ray, 3D
- Experience in automatic assembly process
- Experience in integration of production testing infrastructure and deployment of production test suites

Preferred qualifications

- Experience on highly concurrent, high throughput systems and knowledge of complex distributed systems
- Knowledge of power distribution and data center mechanical cooling systems
- Master's degree or equivalent, or experience with DFx (Design for cost, test, manufacturing)
- 6+ years of maintenance or engineering experience, or experience with CAD software (AutoCAD, REVIT, BIM 360, etc.)
- Experience in problem solving and data analytics
- Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)

title: Sr. Builder - Mobile (Platform), Ring
descriptionHtml:
Ring is redefining how millions of people interact with their homes every single day. As a Senior Builder on the App Platform team, you won't just write code — you'll set the technical direction for one of the most widely-used connected device applications in the world. Native mobile is the foundation our customers rely on, and we need engineers with deep iOS or Android expertise — ideally both, or equivalent depth in a cross-platform framework like React Native — to architect what comes next.

This is a role for someone who sees AI not as a buzzword but as a fundamental shift in how software is built, tested, shipped, and maintained. You'll champion an AI-powered software development lifecycle across the mobile organization, influencing how hundreds of engineers build applications. Your mastery of modern mobile development — Swift, Kotlin, React Native, the latest platform APIs, modern architectural patterns, and the tooling that surrounds them — will be instrumental in charting Ring's path toward faster iteration cycles without sacrificing the quality and performance our customers expect at scale.

The App Platform team sets the overall technical direction for mobile development across Ring and Blink. You'll be a key member of this team, making decisions that ripple across our entire mobile engineering organization.

Key job responsibilities
You will:

- Define and drive the technical strategy for Ring's mobile architecture, balancing development velocity with the performance and reliability customers expect from a home security product
- Champion AI-powered development practices across the mobile organization — from AI-assisted code generation and automated testing to intelligent code review and predictive quality assurance
- Architect mobile solutions that serve tens of millions of daily active users on iOS and Android
- Establish frameworks, SDKs, tooling, and best practices that accelerate feature development, improve code quality, increase testability, strengthen observability, and streamline the path from idea to production
- Drive continuous improvement in CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, modularization, and release engineering for large-scale codebases
- Mentor and influence engineers across the organization, raising the bar for mobile development practices and fostering a culture of technical excellence and experimentation
- Partner with product, UX, backend, and infrastructure teams to deliver cohesive features that span the full stack of Ring's connected device ecosystem

A day in the life
As a Senior Builder on the App Platform team, you will:

- Shape the future of how Ring builds mobile software — your architectural and tooling decisions will define the development experience for teams across the organization
- Tackle novel challenges that come with operating a large-scale production application serving millions of daily users
- Experiment with and operationalize AI-powered development workflows, identifying where AI can eliminate toil, catch defects earlier, and accelerate delivery
- Engage in deep technical discussions about application architecture, rendering performance, state management, and platform-specific tradeoffs with some of the best mobile engineers in the industry
- Build platform capabilities and infrastructure that protect millions of homes — your work has real, tangible impact on people's sense of safety and connection

About the team
Ring's App Platform team is the technical backbone of our mobile development organization. We own the cross-cutting concerns — architecture, tooling, frameworks, performance, and developer experience — that enable dozens of feature teams to ship high-quality software to tens of millions of users. We combine the ambition and speed of a startup with the scale, resources, and impact of Amazon. If you want to work on problems where your decisions matter at massive scale, and where you have the freedom to chart a genuinely new course, this is the team.

You'll work closely with senior leadership every day. Ring is intentionally structured to break down the corporate org-chart barriers that slow teams down — builders sit shoulder-to-shoulder with the leaders setting direction, and decisions happen in the room rather than three layers up. That leadership is deeply hands-on, actively reshaping how we think about AI in software development, and shaped by a vision that has redefined what neighborhood safety looks like for communities around the world. As a Senior Builder on App Platform, you won't just receive that vision — you'll help carry it forward into how Ring builds mobile software.

Basic qualifications

- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- 7+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 7+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 7+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 7+ years of professional software development experience building mobile applications
- 5+ years of deep native iOS (Swift/Objective-C) or Android (Kotlin/Java) development, with working knowledge of the other platform — or equivalent depth building production mobile apps with React Native or a comparable cross-platform framework, with strong familiarity with at least one underlying native platform
- Demonstrated experience building and operating applications at large scale (millions of daily active users)
- Experience designing and implementing modern mobile architectures (e.g., MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, unidirectional data flow) using current platform tooling (SwiftUI/UIKit, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Combine, etc.)
- Strong command of the full mobile SDLC including CI/CD, automated testing, release management, and production monitoring
- Experience leading technical initiatives that span multiple teams or influence organizational engineering practices

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience building mobile platform SDKs, shared libraries, or developer tooling consumed by other engineering teams
- Demonstrated adoption of AI-powered development tools and practices (AI-assisted coding, automated test generation, intelligent code review, AI-driven debugging)
- Experience integrating cross-platform frameworks (React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform) into existing native applications, or operating hybrid native + cross-platform architectures at scale
- Experience with monorepo tooling, modularization strategies, or build system optimization (Bazel, Gradle, SwiftPM, Tuist) for large mobile codebases
- Experience with streaming video, real-time communication protocols (WebRTC, HLS, RTSP), or media playback at scale
- Experience with connected device ecosystems (IoT, Bluetooth, local network protocols, device pairing/provisioning)
- Performance optimization experience for resource-constrained environments (battery, memory, network)

title: Account Manager (Hi-tech/Semiconductor/Manufacturing), High Tech Semiconductor BD Team
descriptionHtml:
Since 2006, Amazon Web Services has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud. AWS has been continually expanding its services to support virtually any workload, and it now has more than 240 fully featured services for compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), mobile, security, hybrid, media, and application development, deployment, and management from 105 Availability Zones within 33 geographic regions, with announced plans for 18 more Availability Zones and 6 more AWS Regions in Malaysia, Mexico, New Zealand, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Thailand. Millions of customers—including the fastest-growing startups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—trust AWS to power their infrastructure, become more agile, and lower costs.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced Business Development professional who is eager to promote the strategic growth and to shape the future of a world which leverages cloud computing.

You will engage with enterprise clients' CXO/VP level strategically as well as closely collaborate with software developers, IT infrastructure, software designers, architects, data scientists, product development for AWS Cloud and AI/ML adoption. In a short, you are not only focusing on Business Development to achieve the defined business KPIs but also acting as a Customer Ambassador to assure their success by adopting the right AWS solutions to solve their business and technical pain-points and to drive their business competitiveness.

title: Junior Logistik Manager
descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.


Key job responsibilities
• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
• Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
• Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
• Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
• Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
• Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
• Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort


A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Mit der Erfüllung unserer Kundenbestellungen (Customer Fulfillment oder CF) fing für Amazon alles an. Das Customer Fulfillment Team hat sich mittlerweile von einem Team von Buchhändler:innen hin zu einem hocherfahrenen globalen Team gewandelt, das täglich mehr als 1,5 Millionen Bestellungen bearbeitet. Das Team bildet die Grundlage unseres Geschäfts und hat uns bei der Verbreiterung in neue Regionen und Dienstleistungen geholfen. Mithilfe aufkommender Technologie sind wir stetig auf der Suche nach Möglichkeiten, eine größere und bessere Produktauswahl anzubieten – die schnell und erschwinglich geliefert wird.
Die CF-Teammitglieder sorgen als allererste dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen mit der Geschwindigkeit erhalten, für die wir bekannt sind. Wir arbeiten in Fulfillment-Centern, die das Herzstück von Amazons dynamischem Betriebsnetz bilden. Unsere Fullfilment-Center werden manchmal auch als die „erste Meile“ (First Mile) bezeichnet – hier starten die meisten Amazon-Pakete ihren Versandweg. Wir unterstützen die Verwaltung eines dynamischen Bestands und ermöglichen schnelle Zustellungen rund um die Uhr.
In unseren Fulfillment-Centern sind vielfältige Mitarbeitergruppen beschäftigt. Es gibt zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für Menschen mit den verschiedensten Fähigkeiten. Einige von uns arbeiten mit physischen Produkten. Andere analysieren Daten und helfen unternehmensweit dabei, intelligente Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Basic qualifications

- Erfolgreich absolviertes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor- oder Master) vor Arbeitsbeginn
- Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenanalysen

Preferred qualifications

- Aktuelles Studium oder kürzlich erworbener Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Logistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
- Interesse eine Führungsaufgabe und ein eigenes Team mit Mitarbeitenden aus der ganzen Welt zu übernehmen
- Erfahrung in der Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Kolleg:innen und Führungskräften
- Erfahrung in einer Logistikumgebung
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

title: RME Technician , BRS2
descriptionHtml:
The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at Amazon is fundamental to our operations – they’re the ones keeping vital machinery running at all times. As an RME Technician, you’ll maintain a wide range of equipment and workspaces while upholding Health and Safety best practices. You'll help to keep your colleagues safe and prevent machine downtime. Our RME Technicians boost the availability and quality of our equipment and work to enhance the operational environment too.

Key job responsibilities
Proactive and preventative maintenance tasks on a wide range of site equipment
Carry out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
Use the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
Uphold all health and safety policies and practices
Support the development and progression of on-site apprentices
Work on continuous improvement projects and roll out best practices across a range of EU sites

A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machinery issues. You’ll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites’ equipment to make sure it’s working safely. As an RME Technician, you’ll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding, and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You’ll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or cutting-edge tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

title: Delivery Service Partner Program, Senior Business Coach
descriptionHtml:
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses.

The Senior Business Coach (BC) helps Amazon improve the flexibility and quality of its delivery network in the Americas—to help fuel a $4B investment in rural communities bringing even faster delivery to our millions of customers in less densely populated areas. This role’s primary focus is supporting DSP operations across the broader Americas delivery network, with particular emphasis on rural market expansion and mature-state optimization. Specifically, BCs support DSPs in making business decisions that enable them to build healthy, sustainable businesses. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs, supporting business planning and strategy and helping owners address business and operational challenges.

As a Senior Business Coach (BC), you will manage a portfolio of Delivery Service Partner (DSP) owners within the Amazon delivery network. With the evolution of delivery modes and rural expansion planned for 2026, and continued strategic expansion into 2027, this role is integral to our program's evolution. Sr. BCs provide strategic guidance to DSP owners throughout their business life cycle of their relationship with Amazon, from pre-launch preparation through mature-state optimization. You will facilitate solution oriented approaches to remove business obstacles and drive continuous improvement in financial performance, operational efficiency, and safety standards across the network. The position requires extensive collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders, including operations managers, program directors, compliance officers, legal counsel, and finance teams. A day in the life

The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional problem solving capabilities, strong business acumen, and the ability to influence outcomes in a dynamic, fast paced environment.

At Amazon Logistics (AMZL), our goal is to provide customers with an incredible package delivery experience through the last mile of the order. descriptionHtml:
Are you energized to drive adoption of GenAI capabilities that upderpin agentic workflows with AWS customers and evolution of these technologies with AWS Product leadership? Are you passionate about helping customers optimize price/performance for AI Inference at scale? AWS is seeking a Go-To-Market (GTM) Specialist to define, build and lead the GTM efforts to scale world-wide adoption of AI Inference through Amazon SageMaker AI. In this role, you will be responsible for defining, building and executing GTM initiatives to accelerate worldwide adoption of Amazon SageMaker AI at customers looking to build, customize, deploy and operationalize GenAI and ML workloads with specific focus on GenAI Inference. You will take your learnings from customer engagements to influence and drive Service evolution and roadmap.

Key job responsibilities
You will bring to bear your unique blend of strong technical background in clustered computing frameworks/distributed systems and business acumen and experience to define and execute go-to-market initiatives for Amazon SageMaker AI. You will be working hand-in-hand with AWS GenAI Solution Architects, Product Managers, Marketing Managers and Geo-aligned field teams to run world-wide sales motions to drive adoption and growth of GenAI Inference that underpins agentic workflows with AWS customers across multiple industry segments worldwide, including large enterprises, ISVs, Digital natives and Startups with optimal price performance.
You will define sales motions including customer segmentation and qualification, positioning of quantitative and qualitative differentiators, and mechanisms and campaigns to accelerate sales cycles. You will execute on these sales motions using direct customer engagements and through Geo Data & AI specialists, to prospect and develop pipeline, launch new opportunities and drive usage and revenue of SageMaker AI for GenAI and ML worldwide.
As the SME on AI Inference, you will help customers understand different types of AI Inference workloads (mapped to AI agentic as well as machine learning use cases), emerging open source technologies as well as native product capabilities for optimizing cost/performance at scale, model cost/TCO and savings from various Inference optimization techniques. You will articulate ease of use of AI Inference in SageMaker with help of product demos, discuss service roadmap, and handle objections from both internal AWS teams and external AWS customers. You will help secure customer quotes, nurture public references and help Marketing team build them into case studies. You will synthesize insights gained from these outbound engagements to help prioritize service roadmap and influence service evolution for AI Inference.

A day in the life
As the owner of key part of the SageMaker AI business worldwide, you will switch between multiple activities and drive multiple deliverables on any given day: You will be leveraging propensity lists of prospect customers and working with field teams to help secure audience with customer stakeholders to drive sales motions related to AI Inference. You will drive initial calls with customers (typically VP/Dir of ML/AI Platforms) in a consultative way to listen to the voice of customer, walk them through the qualitative and quantitative differentiators of our offering through live demos, case studies, help customers understand pricing and savings packages, get feedback on customer’s current use of SageMaker AI and secure workshops/ PoVs/ PoCs for evaluation. You will solicit and help current customers commit to a public quote or reference, or co-present in a webinar or at an upcoming AWS event. You will develop and update sales motion assets on a regular basis. You will conduct enablement sessions with field teams to teach them how to execute on the sales motions. You will conduct customer facing webinars to drive awareness of SageMaker Inference. You will collect and pass on product feedback (backed by customer evidence) to service team, and will participate in roadmap prioritization sessions to help influence product roadmap for AI Inference. You will document customer and market insights to share with rest of the team and with leadership.

About the team
We are a team of Generative AI Go-to-Market specialists with a unique blend of technical/specialist sales, product management, and technical business development backgrounds, driving global adoption and expansion of Amazon SageMaker AI as a flagship AWS managed GenAI Service.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- 5+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
- Experience selling enterprise software or cloud-based applications
- Experience explaining complex technical concepts to various business and technical audiences
- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of highly technical pre-sales roles at B2B companies (Enterprises, Startups, System Integration Services Companies, preferably in ML and/or AI). SME in cluster-based computing frameworks such as Kubernetes and Ray.
- Experience building sales plays and playbooks, prospecting for, advancing and closing technical sales pipeline to drive adoption of products and services in ML or AI focused on model Inference. Experience teaching account teams how to sell technical products and services
- Experience structuring and running benchmark initiatives, documenting optimization strategies, building TCO/pricing models and demonstrating cost/performance differentiation to customers.

title: 2027 MBA Pathways Full-time Operations Manager (Canada-Wide Opportunities)
descriptionHtml:
Launch your career with Amazon by solving complex operational challenges that impact millions of customers worldwide. As an Operations Manager in our Pathways Program — designed for recent MBA or Master's grads ready to make an immediate impact — you'll lead cross-functional teams, manage people, processes, and technology, and drive continuous improvement across one of the most innovative operations environments globally. From Day 1, you'll work on real business challenges, optimizing operations, enhancing the customer experience, and implementing scalable solutions across our global network. This is your opportunity to develop strategic leadership capabilities while building expertise in one of the world's most complex operational environments.

PROGRAM OVERVIEW:
Pathways is Amazon's three-year Operations Leadership Development Program, designed to cultivate the next generation of senior operations leadership at Amazon. Participants will gain high visibility with senior executives while tackling challenging assignments across diverse sites, technologies, and geographies within our world-class operations network. Day to day, participants will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex operational challenges, take on progressively greater responsibilities, and work on real business initiatives that directly impact our operations. Along the way, participants will learn from experienced leaders, participate in cohort-based learning sessions, and build a network of peers who will become their professional community throughout their career at Amazon. This program is designed to build global leadership capabilities and prepare participants for executive-level impact.

- Please note that this posting is for opportunities in Canada only. Ideal candidates are students or recent graduates of an MBA or Master's program in Canada. Students interested in US-based opportunities should apply directly that posting.
- This program is open to external candidates only; current Amazon employees are not eligible to apply. The role appears on Amazon's internal portal solely for employee referral purposes.
- Candidates should be currently enrolled in an MBA or Master's program, or have graduated from one within the past 24 months.
- This role is for Pathways positions at Amazon operations facilities across Canada. Successful candidates will work with their recruiter to be matched to a site prior to receiving an offer.
- Candidates who apply to multiple Amazon MBA roles will only be selected to interview for one.
- Annual Pathways cohorts start between January and July. This application is for opportunities with start dates in 2027.

WHAT TO EXPECT:
Pathways graduates may lead organizations of nearly 4,000 people, manage labor budgets exceeding $2.5 million per week, and oversee $1B+ in capital projects. Here's how the program gets you there:

Step 1: Area Manager - Hit the ground running by leading 50–100 associates on the front lines of one of Amazon's world-class fulfillment, sortation, or delivery centers. This is where you'll build your operational foundation — learning how to lead people and systems at scale.

Step 2: Operations Manager - Take on greater responsibility by leading and developing other managers. You'll drive process improvements and collaborate cross-functionally across your site, region, and network.

Step 3: Senior Operations Manager - Graduate from the program as a senior leader known for operational excellence. In this role, you'll lead through others to execute regional or network-level initiatives — whether that's launching a new business, leading a major project, or running an entire site.

SITE PLACEMENT & EXPECTED HOURS:
- Must be willing to relocate within Canada at time of hire. Placement is driven primarily by business need, with consideration given to individual location preferences.
- The role is based in one of Amazon's operations facilities across Canada, including fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations, Amazon Air, return centers, or other warehouse environments. Successful candidates will work with their recruiter to be matched to a site prior to receiving an offer.
- This is a demanding, hands-on role where hours may vary based on seasonal peaks and operational needs. Candidates should expect to work weekends, holidays, and/or overnight shifts, with overtime as needed.

COMPENSATION:
Total compensation for Pathways Operations includes three elements: (1) Base pay, (2) Sign-on bonus (paid over first two years), (3) Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).


Key job responsibilities
- Lead, coach, and develop your team, fostering a culture of accountability, growth, high performance, and customer obsession
- Partner with senior leadership to identify and solve complex business and operational challenges, thinking both strategically and tactically
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing operational data, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing scalable solutions
- Make real-time decisions in a fast-paced environment, balancing competing priorities to meet safety, quality, and productivity goals
- Collaborate cross-functionally with technology, engineering, and supply chain teams to improve end-to-end processes

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of professional or military experience
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a MBA or equivalent Master's level education degree
- Work flexible hours as business demands, including overnight, weekends and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of professional work (non-internship) experience
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, an MBA in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics, or a related field
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Master of Engineering degree in one of the following disciplines: Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Systems, or Computer Engineering

title: Pre-Construction Manager, D&C
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Engineering Services (GES) North America Design & Construction team is seeking a Preconstruction Manager to serve as Amazon's owner's representative during the preconstruction phase of facility delivery. In this role, you will independently manage difficult, cross-functional industrial preconstruction projects — from site selection and validation through design management, permitting, and contract execution — for new builds, retrofits, expansions, and program initiatives across your assigned region.
You will partner with internal teams — including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Finance, and Construction — and external stakeholders — including architects, engineers, developers, landlords, and permitting agencies — to establish scope, budget, and schedule, and to ensure timely receipt of building and site permits. You are accountable for a clean, well-defined handoff to the Construction Manager, and you remain a key support resource for the construction team throughout the project lifecycle.
Projects include fulfillment centers, sortation centers, delivery stations, and auxiliary buildings supporting Amazon's logistics network, ranging from targeted renovations to large-scale new facility builds. This role combines construction engineering, planning, project management, real estate development, multi-disciplinary design management, and contract management.
This role requires 60% regional travel and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.


Key job responsibilities
• Independently manage difficult, cross-functional industrial pre-construction projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution
• Work with internal and external stakeholders — including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Entitlements, Construction, Finance, Launch/Startup, architects, engineers, permitting agencies, developers, and landlords — to secure resources, scope infrastructure builds, set priorities and milestones, and drive delivery to meet deadlines
• Lead site selection and validation, scope development, and design management — coordinating with design teams to develop site plans and composite floor plans in compliance with Amazon's design standards and operational requirements
• Manage multiple concurrent large industrial projects across various locations simultaneously
• Perform conceptual estimating and pricing reviews for scope inclusions and exclusions; negotiate the cost of work with developers, general contractors, and design consultants
• Own comprehensive budget tracking, schedule management, and cashflow forecasting across assigned projects
• Manage vendor procurement and oversee professional service providers, ensuring their skills and competencies meet the requirements for entitling properties and projects
• Coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) for permitting, regulatory compliance, and approvals; understand zoning, planning, fire code, and building code requirements
• Review and analyze design and construction contracts, related exhibits, and lease agreements; provide detailed analysis of technical matters and site-specific deal structures and terms
• Review additional reports including noise and traffic studies and environmental assessments
• Partner with the Transaction team and developers to optimize schedule and strategy for entitlements and long-lead procurement
• Keep scope under control and accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and escalating appropriately
• Prepare and present project status and risk reports; translate technical documents and information into clear, concise narratives for leadership and customers
• Identify and resolve upstream issues proactively to support a clean hand off to the Construction Manager; remain a support resource for the construction team throughout the project lifecycle
• Champion Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams during the pre-construction phase
• Optimize pre-construction processes and implement improvements in procedures and playbooks to improve project efficiency and delivery
• Seek sustainable, environmentally responsible solutions throughout the pre-construction process in alignment with Amazon's building practices

title: 2027 AWS - Auszubildende/n als Elektroniker/-in für Betriebstechnik (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Chance: Die Technik hinter der Cloud

Du willst wissen, wie die Stromversorgung und Infrastruktur eines der modernsten Rechenzentren Europas funktioniert und sie aktiv mitgestalten? Dann starte deine Ausbildung zum/zur Elektroniker:in für Betriebstechnik bei Amazon Web Services (AWS) in Frankfurt am Main.

Beginn: 01.08.2027
Dauer: 3,5 Jahre
Berufsschule: Werner-von-Siemens-Schule Frankfurt

Bei AWS hältst du die elektrischen Systeme am Laufen, die unsere Cloud-Infrastruktur rund um die Uhr verfügbar machen. Stromversorgung, Klimatechnik, Sicherheitssysteme, USV-Anlagen und Generatoren, du sorgst dafür, dass alles stabil und sicher läuft. Wenn tausende Server weltweit erreichbar sind, steckt deine Arbeit dahinter.

Diese Ausbildung findet in einem hochmodernen Rechenzentrum statt, nicht in einem Lager oder Produktionsbetrieb. Hier zählen Präzision, Verantwortung und technisches Verständnis.

Du packst gerne an, arbeitest sorgfältig und willst früh Verantwortung für Systeme übernehmen, die wirklich zählen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Key job responsibilities
Was Du lernen wirst:

• Installation, Überwachung und Wartung von Stromversorgungs-, Klima- und Sicherheitssystemen
• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen an Anlagen, die für die Verfügbarkeit der IT-Infrastruktur entscheidend sind
• Grundlagen und Vertiefung in Elektrotechnik, Hydraulik, Pneumatik und Steuerungstechnik
• Messen, Prüfen und Programmieren technischer Komponenten
• Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Technikern zur Sicherstellung eines unterbrechungsfreien Betriebs

A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst du an der Werner-von-Siemens-Schule in Frankfurt, während du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei AWS im Rechenzentrum erwirbst.

Ein typischer Tag? Du überprüfst am Morgen die elektrischen Versorgungssysteme, führst Messungen an einer USV-Anlage durch und dokumentierst die Ergebnisse. Am Nachmittag analysierst du eine Störungsmeldung an der Klimaanlage, lokalisierst das Problem und arbeitest mit dem Team an der Behebung. Am nächsten Tag programmierst du eine Steuerung, unterstützt bei der vorbeugenden Wartung oder begleitest die Inbetriebnahme neuer elektrischer Infrastruktur.

Du arbeitest von Anfang an Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Techniker:innen, die dich fördern und fordern. Du übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung, probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

Das bieten wir:
• Praxisphasen am Standort Amazon Web Services Frankfurt, einem der modernsten Rechenzentren Europas
• Einblicke in elektrische Steuerungstechnik, Mittelspannungsanlagen, USV-Systeme, Gebäudesystemtechnik und IT-nahe Infrastruktur
• Begleitende Schulungen zu Projektarbeit, Sicherheitsstandards und kundenorientiertem Arbeiten
• Breites Angebot an Betriebssport- und Interessensgruppen (z.B. Firmenläufe, Team-Events)
• Entwicklungsperspektiven nach erfolgreichem Abschluss

Basic qualifications

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B1)
- Erfolgreicher Schulabschluss (mindestens mittlerer Bildungsabschluss)
- Begeisterung für Elektrotechnik und technische Systeme
- Du magst den Umgang mit Menschen, bist offen für Neues, besitzt eine gute Auffassungsgabe und hast Spaß daran, mit anderen zusammenzuarbeiten und etwas zu bewegen
- Mindestens 18 Jahre alt zum Ausbildungsbeginn

Preferred qualifications

title: Design Systems Designer, Amazon Health
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Health Services, we're building a unified design system that powers consistent, high-quality experiences across our clinical and consumer products — including a growing suite of AI-powered interfaces. We're looking for a Design Systems Designer who brings strong visual design craft, systems thinking, and curiosity about AI-forward design to help scale our component library, define visual patterns, and build the infrastructure that enables dozens of product designers to move faster with higher fidelity.



This is an opportunity to shape the foundational design language for AHS — working on components, tokens, interaction patterns, motion standards, AI interaction patterns, and accessibility guidelines that directly impact every product surface our customers touch. As AI capabilities expand across our products, you'll help define how AI-driven experiences look, move, and behave within the system — ensuring they feel cohesive and trustworthy. You'll also bring AI into the design systems workflow itself: leveraging AI tools to accelerate component creation, automate documentation, explore variant generation, and streamline design-to-code handoff. You'll partner with designers, engineers, and AI/ML teams to ensure what we build is beautiful, usable, and scalable.


Key job responsibilities
Design and maintain scalable UI components, patterns, and guidelines within the AHS design system

Define and evolve visual tokens (color, typography, spacing, elevation, motion) that ensure consistency across products

Audit product surfaces for system adherence and identify opportunities for new or improved patterns

Create detailed component specs including states, responsive behavior, accessibility requirements, and usage guidance

Define and document design patterns for AI-driven experiences (generative UI, conversational interfaces, AI-assisted workflows) within the system

Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure coded components match design intent

Identify and implement AI-powered workflows that accelerate design systems operations — variant generation, automated specs, documentation, and design-to-code handoff

Contribute to design system documentation, making it easy for other designers to adopt and contribute

Participate in design critiques and system reviews, providing feedback grounded in systematic thinking

A day in the life
As a Design Systems Designer at AHS, you might start your morning using AI tooling to generate component variant explorations that would have taken hours manually — then refining the best options with your craft eye. After standup with the systems team, you'll spend focused time in Figma evolving a component's visual states, leveraging AI-assisted prototyping to test responsive behavior across breakpoints. In the afternoon you'll partner with an engineer to review a coded implementation against your spec — possibly using a design-to-code pipeline to bridge the gap — then collaborate with design and tech teams to define patterns for a new UI surface. You'll contribute to automated documentation workflows and end the day exploring visual directions for an upcoming token update — balancing craft with systematic rigor and a bias toward experimentation.

About the team
You'll join the AHS Design Systems team within the Amazon Health Services organization — a small, focused group building the foundational layer that enables all of our product designers to do their best work. We're actively integrating AI into our own workflows — from component generation to documentation to code handoff — and we want people who are excited to push that forward. You'll work alongside teammates in Seattle, San Francisco, and Boston, partnering closely with product designers, front-end engineers, and accessibility specialists. We value craft, experimentation, and supporting each other's growth.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of design experience
- Have an available online portfolio
- Experience working in a collaborative team environment to deliver high-quality design solutions
- Portfolio demonstrating strong visual design skills and systematic design thinking — showing how individual components connect to a larger system
- Experience building and maintaining design systems, pattern libraries, or component libraries
- Understanding of how design decisions translate to code
- Strong eye for typography, color, spacing, and visual hierarchy
- Active use of or strong curiosity about AI tools to accelerate design systems work — component generation, variant exploration, automated documentation, design-to-code pipelines

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of mobile and web design patterns and accessibility standards
- Experience with motion design
- Experience building or contributing to a production design system used by multiple product teams
- Experience designing patterns for AI/ML interfaces — generative UI, conversational experiences, or AI-assisted workflows
- Familiarity with AI tooling for design workflows (generative AI for exploration, prototyping automation, design-to-code pipelines)

title: Theatrical PR Specialist, MGM Theatrical
descriptionHtml:
Interested in shaping the future of movies and television as an integral part of a world-leading global communications team? Amazon MGM Studios brings together the world's best filmmakers with the most passionate communities in a way no other entertainment brand can. We deliver distinctive, critically acclaimed and award-winning original movies like Project Hail Mary, The Sheep Detectives, American Fiction, The Beekeeper, and Challengers.

Amazon MGM Studios is seeking a culturally fluent, strategically minded, and execution-driven National Theatrical PR Specialist to drive day-to-day PR campaign strategy and activities for the studio's theatrical film slate. This role will work in close partnership with senior national publicity leadership to develop and execute earned media campaigns that break through culture — identifying, creating, and amplifying moments that generate conversation, critical engagement, and audience excitement across the full lifecycle of a theatrical release.

The ideal candidate brings a sophisticated understanding of the modern media landscape — from legacy outlets and broadcast to digital editorial, podcasts, and emerging platforms — and can identify innovative pathways to earned coverage that go beyond traditional publicity playbooks. This is a role for someone who thinks creatively about how stories get told, who is telling them, and where audiences are actually paying attention — and who can execute against that thinking with rigor, precision, speed and creativity.
This role requires equal parts strategic instinct and operational excellence: the ability to conceive a breakthrough campaign beat and then manage every detail required to bring it to life — from pitch through placement, from press day logistics through premiere execution. The successful candidate will be a proactive self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, manages multiple high-profile campaigns simultaneously, and brings genuine passion for film and pop culture to everything they do.


Key job responsibilities
• Drive day-to-day national PR campaign strategy and activities for assigned theatrical titles — from production through release and awards positioning
• Develop and execute earned media strategies that generate cultural conversation, critical engagement, and audience excitement across all editorial platforms
• Identify and create breakthrough earned media moments that transcend traditional publicity — developing activations, and approaches that position films within broader cultural conversations
• Manage press outreach for assigned titles
• Develop campaign messaging, talking points, positioning documents, and press materials for each title
• Monitor cultural conversation, competitive landscape, and media trends to identify real-time opportunities for campaign amplification and press engagement
• Track and analyze media coverage and campaign performance
• Serve as a day-to-day liaison with talent representatives — managing approvals and scheduling
• Talent handle at press days, junkets, premieres, and publicity events as needed
• Lead planning and execution of press days, junkets, screenings, and publicity events — managing logistics, press confirmations, talent flow, materials, and day-of execution
• Develop innovative press event formats and activations that generate earned media beyond standard interview rotations
• Coordinate with cross-functional partners (marketing, social, creative, distribution) to ensure that PR is integrated into broader campaign strategy
• Maintain deep, current knowledge of the evolving national media landscape — understanding which platforms, and formats reach which audiences, and how influence patterns are shifting
• Cultivate and maintain relationships editorial voices across the full media ecosystem
• Serve as a cultural resource for the team — staying current on pop culture, social trends, and audience behaviors
• Serve as day-to-day point of contact for retained PR agencies and specialist vendors as assigned
• Track agency progress against campaign goals,
• Manage campaign timelines, status documents, and internal tracking systems
• Prepare weekly status reports and post-campaign analysis
• Develop presentation decks and materials for filmmaker meetings, internal stakeholder reviews, and cross-functional campaign discussions
• Participate in cross-functional meetings with marketing, social, creative, international, and distribution teams

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of recent professional communications or public relations experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Can show strong verbal and written communication skills
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, SharePoint, and PowerPoint)
- Proven track record of securing high-impact earned media placements across all editorial platforms
- Demonstrated ability to develop and execute national PR campaigns from strategy through execution
- Strong existing relationships with entertainment journalists, critics, editors, and producers
- Experience coordinating press junkets, press days, talent interviews, and premiere events
- Proven ability to manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders
- Experience working directly with talent representatives (publicists, agents, managers)
- Strong organizational and project management skills

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of theatrical publicity experience at a major studio, entertainment company, or leading PR agency
- Demonstrated ability to conceive and execute innovative, culture-breaking earned media moments
- Established relationships with editorial voices across emerging media platforms — not just legacy press
- Experience developing campaign strategies and presentations to filmmakers and senior stakeholders
- Understanding of the awards campaign landscape and experience supporting awards publicity
- Working knowledge of social media dynamics, content creator ecosystems
- Experience managing or coordinating with PR agencies and external vendors
- Budget management experience including invoice processing, PO tracking, and spend reconciliation
- Familiarity with AI tools for media research, campaign measurement, and workflow optimization
- Genuine love of all film genres and pop culture — with an ability to articulate what's culturally resonant and why

title: Pr Solution Architect, Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Strategic Accounts team is committed to helping some of the largest and most complex customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable & technically capable customers, to design cloud architectures utilising AWS services. As part of this team, you will blend business acumen with technical guidance to effectively engage with Enterprise scale organizations at all stages of cloud adoption, helping them reinvent their businesses using AWS technology, guiding them on their cloud journey.

In this role, you will help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. You will engage with AWS product owners to influence product direction and help our customers develop their new markets by utilising AWS Services and newly defined architectural approaches.

Through your work with our customers you will define patterns and trends that can be applied across broad industries and segments to help other customers accelerate their innovation.

As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate and scale existing workloads in the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.

For this role, we are looking for candidates who have technical breadth complimented by technical depth in one or two areas, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Strong communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging our customers at all levels of seniority.

If you are excited about the prospect of using your architecture experience to assist our most valuable customers, tackling challenging problems, have a hand in shaping the future of cloud adoption, enhancing and growing your own skills, and having fun, then we would love to hear from you.

As a key member of the team, ensure success by formulating, co-authoring and executing a technical and sales strategy to aid the customers adoption of AWS technology.

Advocate for and Influence the AWS technology strategy internally and externally, at industry events, meet-ups, and summits.
Author AWS customer-facing publications such as solutions, blog posts and white-papers.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Amazon Leo - OISL
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive flight software delivery for the OISL program. In this role, you will be the central coordination point for flight software builds, integration, test, and deployment across multiple hardware and software systems, including the spacecraft flight computer, GNC, networking, and optical subsystems. You will work at the intersection of embedded software engineering, systems integration, and cross-program coordination to ensure OISL flight software ships on time with high quality and at scale. Specifically, you will support the design, implementation, and release of software systems that control, monitor, and manage space and ground optical terminals.

This is a high-visibility role that requires deep technical fluency in software systems, strong program management fundamentals, and the ability to operate across organizational boundaries in a fast-paced, first-of-its-kind environment.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Support the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for flight software — driving release schedules, integration test campaigns, and deployment coordination across concurrent programs.

Collaborate with Software Development Managers as a peer to drive integrated delivery, resolve competing priorities, and maintain accountability across all active workstreams.

Coordinate cross-program feature development with Technical Program Managers and hardware teams — aligning interfaces, managing dependencies, and removing blockers.

Build and maintain program roadmaps, schedules, and resource plans; identify critical path risks and trade-offs and drive decisions to resolution.

Define, track, and mitigate software program risks and cross-team integration risks with clear ownership and escalation paths.

Partner with mission operations, network operations, and cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, remove blockers, and protect team focus.

Deliver clear program status reporting across scope, schedule, quality, and risk for leadership reviews and business cadences.

About the team
You will join a multi-disciplinary team of top-notch engineers whose work spans an unusually wide aperture: embedded flight software running on satellites in orbit, cloud-based systems powering mission and network operations, automation frameworks that keep a growing constellation healthy, and AI-driven capabilities that make our optical links smarter with every orbit. We collaborate closely with optical, electrical, firmware, opto-mechanical, and operations teams — and with partner organizations including Mission Operations and Optical Network Operations — to deliver one of the most advanced optical communication systems ever built.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of experience managing programs involving critical systems, embedded systems, or flight software
- Experience driving cross-functional coordination across hardware and software teams
- Experience with software build, integration, and release management processes
- Experience managing program schedules, roadmaps, and resource planning

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
- Experience in aerospace, satellite, or space systems programs
- Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS), embedded software development lifecycles, and hardware-software integration
- Familiarity with optical communications, networking protocols, or satellite constellation operations
- Experience managing programs with concurrent development generations (e.g., block upgrades, next-gen architectures)

title: Regional RME Manager - Sub Same Day, IntlRME - LATAM - Brazil
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, safety-oriented and driven people.

The Regional RME Manager — SSD Brazil will own reliability, maintenance, and engineering operations across Amazon's Sub Same Day (SSD) network in Brazil. This is a regional role responsible for building and scaling the SSD maintenance organization — covering cold-chain and HVAC-R infrastructure, co-located operations within existing Delivery Stations, and standalone facilities. The role includes budget ownership, maintenance planning, vendor management, remote monitoring of cold storage systems, and team development under the International RME framework (AMS - Amazon Maintenance System).

This is a highly ambiguous environment — the SSD program is rapidly evolving, with project scopes, timelines, and operational models still being defined. The successful candidate must be comfortable navigating uncertainty, proactively defining RME strategies where no playbook exists, and influencing cross-functional teams to ensure maintenance and reliability requirements are embedded into program decisions from the start.

Key Responsibilities:

- Own end-to-end building and facilities maintenance across all SSD nodes in Brazil — standalone and co-located within existing Delivery Stations
- Ensure a safe work environment applying Amazon Safety Policy, Permit to Work (PtW), LOTO standards, and VSOP procedures
- Lead equipment maintenance for cold-chain infrastructure (walk-in coolers, freezers, refrigerated display units), HVAC-R systems, conveyors, workstations, labeling machines, PLC control systems, and electrical systems
- Implement and operate remote monitoring systems for cold storage — temperature tracking, alarm management, and rapid response protocols to ensure food safety compliance and prevent temperature excursions
- Develop and deploy Preventive Maintenance routines aligned with AMS standards, with focus on cold-chain asset criticality
- Implement Condition-Based Maintenance (CBM) on critical cold-chain assets to advance toward predictive maintenance maturity
- Own the RME launch playbook for new SSD nodes — from Design for Maintainability reviews through commissioning and steady-state handover
- Scale RME coverage across a rapidly growing network, establishing cluster-based support models
- Manage 3rd party service providers through structured SLAs, KPI tracking, and regular business reviews
- Ensure cold storage food safety compliance — temperature monitoring, HACCP-aligned protocols, and regulatory requirements for perishable grocery, partnering with Grocery/Perishables and Quality Assurance teams
- Own the SSD RME budget for Brazil (OPEX and CAPEX), drive spare parts optimization, and coordinate vendor negotiations
- Actively participate in SSD project definition and design reviews — represent RME requirements in new node design, equipment selection, and operational model decisions. Have backbone to advocate for reliability and maintainability standards, even when priorities compete, always grounded in the impact to the end customer
- Define RME strategy for SSD in Brazil in a new environment
- Develop maintenance models, gearing ratios, vendor strategies, and technology roadmaps from scratch, adapting as the program evolves
- Partner cross-functionally with AMZL RME, SSD Operations, Grocery/Perishables, Real Estate, and Automation teams
- Provide immediate technical guidance to operations during critical events
- Be a leader within the group and across partner teams — positive, creative, and driven to find solutions in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Reliability Engineering
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Experience in distribution or manufacturing field with equivalent mechanical or electrical field
- Experience in facilities management, office management, corporate administrative services, or hospitality management

title: Sr. Software Engineer- AI/ML, AWS Neuron
descriptionHtml:
Shape the Future of AI Accelerators at AWS Neuron
We build Amazon Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon’s custom machine learning accelerators, Inferentia and Trainium.

As a Senior Software Engineer on our Machine Learning Applications team, you will optimize the world's most demanding AI models at a scale few engineers ever get to work on. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology.

You can learn more about Neuron
https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com
https://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/ https://github.com/aws/aws-neuron-sdk https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-success

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
This role will help lead the efforts in building distributed inference support for Pytorch in the Neuron SDK. This role will tune these models to ensure highest performance and maximize the efficiency of them running on the customer AWS Trainium and Inferentia silicon and servers. Strong software development using Python, System level programming and ML knowledge are both critical to this role. Our engineers collaborate across compiler, runtime, framework, and hardware teams to optimize machine learning workloads for our global customer base. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and machine learning systems, you'll bring expertise in low-level optimization, system architecture, and ML model acceleration. In this role, you will:

* Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models including GPT, Kimi, and Qwen on custom AI accelerators.
* Participate in all stages of the ML system development lifecycle including distributed computing based architecture design, implementation, performance profiling, low level optimizations, and production deployment.
* Build infrastructure to systematically analyze and onboard multiple models with diverse architecture.
* Design and implement high-performance kernels and features for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models
* Analyze and optimize system-level performance across multiple generations of Neuron hardware
* Conduct detailed performance analysis using profiling tools to identify and resolve bottlenecks
* Implement optimizations such as fusion, sharding, tiling, and scheduling
* Work directly with customers to enable and optimize their ML models on AWS accelerators
* Collaborate across teams to develop innovative optimization techniques
• Develop kernels to improve model efficiency on Amazon AI Accelerators
• Transform complex tensor operations into highly optimized graph implementations
• Optimize state-of-the-art language, vision, and multimodal generative AI models for Neuron hardware

What Makes This Role Unique:
• Direct influence on AWS's AI Accelerator used by thousands of ML applications
• Full-stack optimization from high-level frameworks to low level primitives
• Collaboration with both open-source ML communities and hardware architecture teams
• Requires passion for performance tuning and system architecture


A day in the life
You will collaborate with a cross-functional team of applied scientists, system engineers, and product managers to deliver state-of-the-art inference capabilities for Generative AI applications. Your work will involve debugging performance issues, optimizing memory usage, and shaping the future of Neuron's inference stack across Amazon and the Open Source Community. As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you’ll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects.

You will also build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base and participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders. You will work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input. You will work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important initiative.

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment.


About the team
At AWS Neuron, we're revolutionizing how the world's most sophisticated AI models run at scale through Amazon's next-generation AI accelerators.
The Inference Enablement and Acceleration team is at the forefront of running a wide range of models and supporting novel architecture alongside maximizing their performance for Amazon's custom ML accelerators. Working across the stack from PyTorch till the hardware-software boundary, our engineers build systematic software stack, innovate new methods and create high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine tuned for optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. The team collaborates with open source ecosystems to provide seamless integration and bring peak performance at scale for customers and developers.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Knowledge of Python and/or C++ programming
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large-scale systems
- Knowledge of system performance, memory management, and parallel computing principles
- Experience owning a performance optimization roadmap and mentoring engineers on optimization

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Knowledge of machine learning model architecture and inference
- Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques
- Hands-on development with PyTorch is preferred
- Experience scaling workloads across multi-GPU and multi-node topologies with NCCL and tensor, pipeline, or expert parallelism

As senior Infrastructure Operations leader, they oversee safety, security, availability, scaling, efficiency, and cost management.

Infrastructure Operations consists of two core functions: Data Center Operations (DCO) and Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO). DCO manages server-level platforms supporting Amazon Retail and Amazon Web Services, while DCEO handles mechanical, electrical, and controls systems for critical environments. We seek a leader with experience in both DCO and DCEO systems. Through operating independently, a physical security team works closely with these functions to protect people, assets, and customer data.

The Cluster Operations Leader builds and leads high-performing teams across these functions. They manage daily operations while applying technical expertise to address emerging challenges. Their role requires both strategic oversight and the ability to dive deep into specific issues.

As a vital member of the management team, the Cluster Operations Leader helps scale the world's largest cloud computing infrastructure. The position demands innovation to solve complex daily challenges and drive operational excellence. descriptionHtml:

As a Senior Solutions Architect at Amazon Web Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to assist and shape the future of a high potential set of digitally native customers. title: Senior Engagement Manager, APJC-Delivery-JAPAN
descriptionHtml:
企業を支える基幹システムの革新に携わり、ビジネストランスフォーメーションと価値創造をリードしませんか？

Amazon Web Services(AWS)のProfessional Servicesでは、企業のオンプレミス環境上にある大規模なワークロードをAWSへの移行を支援し、これらのシステムをモダナイズすることで、お客様のデジタルトランスフォーメーションをより俊敏かつ弾力的な加速の実現をリードする Senior Engagement Managerを募集しています。

お客様の業務を支える基幹システムはビジネスを支える重要なシステムです。多くの企業において、こうしたシステムは、オンプレミス環境で稼働しています。こうしたシステムは安定かつ堅剛である一方で、定常的な運用コスト負荷、短期間で変化するビジネスニーズへの柔軟な対応が容易でないなどが課題になっています。従来のアプリケーション資産を継承しモダナイズすることでビジネスに俊敏性と持続性を実現化することは大きなチャレンジです。近年、金融業など大規模なシステムを抱える企業でもこのような取り組みが始まっています。モダナイズされたアプリケーションアセットを Amazon Web Services(AWS) のマネージドサービス上で動かすことは、単なるプラットフォームやアプリケーションアセットの刷新にとどまらない、お客様の未来を作る仕事です。モダナイゼーションによってコスト削減、効率化が実現すれば、生成AIなどの最新の技術サービスの活用による新しいアプリケーション開発と新しいビジネスサービスのプロダクトリリースなどの長期的な好循環と価値の享受が期待できます。このようなお客様のビジネストランスフォーメーションの実現をプロジェクト全体のマネジメントとデリバリーの観点からリードするのがSenior Engagement Managerです。AWSコンサルタント・パートナー・お客様チームを率いて大規模なマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションプロジェクトを成功に導く意欲のある方を求めています。

Key job responsibilities
当ポジションのコンサルタントは、AWSコンサルタント、パートナー、お客様のプロジェクトチームをリードし、大規模なクラウドマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションエンゲージメントの計画策定からデリバリーまでを一貫して推進します。お客様の経営課題・ビジネス目標を把握し、それを実現するためのマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションの全体計画（スコープ、スケジュール、体制、リスク管理）を策定・管理します。 オンプレミス環境上のワークロードの評価・計画・環境設計・移行実行を、関連する技術コンサルタントやパートナーと連携して推進します。最新のAWSのAIテクノロジーも活用したスケーラブルなモダナイゼーション手法と自動化ツール技術をエンゲージメント全体に適用することで、大規模なオンプレミス環境からAWSへの移行およびモダナイゼーションを加速することを目指します。また、プロジェクトの進捗・課題・リスクを適時に可視化し、お客様の経営層・プロジェクト責任者に対してプロアクティブに報告・提案を行います。お客様の成功のために、複数のProfessional Servicesメンバー、AWSパートナー、グローバルのProfessional Servicesを含む社内の多くのAWSチームと連携し、プロジェクトのギャップを特定・解消してお客様の成功をリードします。こうした支援を通じた市場へのサービス投入の短縮化やビジネスインパクトの大きなシステムのクラウドへのマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションの実現はとてもエキサイティングな経験になるはずです。価値提供にまい進することでプロジェクトマネージャーとしての成長も期待できます。

A day in the life
お客様に対してチームで対応するなど体制に柔軟性があり、コアなしフレックス制度やリモートワークも活用し、柔軟でライフステージに合った働きやすい環境が整っております。

About the team
