title: Senior Technical Program Manager, AWS Hardware Engineering Services, Specialized Platforms and Servers
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Hardware Engineering is a fast growing and leading-edge research and development team that creates enterprise compute and storage server designs for our innovative web service and e-commerce technology platforms. Our designs are industry-leading in terms of performance, frugality and operational excellence, and are critical to the success of the AWS business and the hundreds of thousands of customers who use utility computing today.

We are seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to define and build the next generation of our cloud servers. Our success depends on our highly respected server infrastructure; we’re handling massive scale and rapid integration of emergent technologies.

The ideal TPM candidate will be an experienced program manager who is skilled in managing hardware product development teams across several geographic regions using a variety of suppliers. The successful candidate will be an innovative self-starter and leader. The candidate will be familiar with the cloud computing industry and AWS offerings and will be passionate about providing the best possible customer experience at the best cost. The candidate will have an obsession with data and precise analysis and will use these as inputs to make decisions.

Key job responsibilities
•You manage large, complex technology initiatives, delivering critical solutions, significant improvements, new mechanisms, or deprecating systems that are no longer needed.
•You successfully manage all stages (from concept to delivery).
•You work closely with your customers to understand their short and long term business goals and product needs.
•You are responsible for the delivery of platforms through driving and coordinating the efforts of an interdisciplinary team across hardware design, component development, firmware, test, and qualification, along with external suppliers and design partners to develop, deploy at scale, and provide ongoing operational support for the servers you deliver.
•You are actively involved in the sustaining operational health of the platforms you support
•You understand the architecture of the systems you work with (e.g., workflows, APIs, runtime characteristics, design limitations, and maintenance requirements). You influence team technical priorities and business strategy through data-driven contributions.
•You communicate ideas effectively, verbally and in writing, to a wide range of audiences including Directors and VPs. You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues (build consensus). You partner successfully with customers, stakeholders, and engineering teams.
•Your program management practices set a great example to others. You routinely and efficiently deliver the right things. You define clear goals and objectives. You drive crisp decisions in your program area about what projects move forward and in what priority order. You proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your team and stakeholders with plans for mitigation before they become roadblocks.
•You are a simplifier. You judiciously add, refine, and remove procedures. By applying project management best practices, you increase the productivity and effectiveness of the teams you work with.

A day in the life
What you will do: As a TPM on the Specialized Platforms and Servers Hardware Engineering team you will be responsible for leading AWS EC2 Enterprise fleet operations and hardware product development programs in a highly cross-functional environment which includes internal customers, external vendors and technology partners. You’ll provide leadership in the application of new technologies to large scale server deployments in a continuous effort to deliver a world-class customer experience at a world-class cost point. This is a fast-paced challenging position, and you’ll work with thought leaders in multiple technology areas. You’ll have high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and you’ll be constantly looking for ways to improve your product’s performance, quality and cost. Using data and key metrics, you will also drive and measure process improvements that enhance our operational effectiveness. You will work in a dynamic, challenging, and fast-changing organization. We’re changing an industry, and we need leaders who are ready for this challenge and who want to reach beyond what is possible today.

You will see many aspects of the Amazon business. You will have a direct impact on our bottom line and the ability to improve things for our developers. You will be part of a growing, fast paced, and fun team. You will have ownership and responsibility for defining and executing processes that deliver both savings and productivity for Amazon.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services is hiring a Senior Product Design Electrical Engineer for our Electrical Products and Services (EPS) team. EPS is a global engineering team within AWS Data Center Engineering, responsible for the design, development, and continuous improvement of electrical power distribution products used across our rapidly expanding data center footprint. Our product portfolio spans the full electrical distribution chain, including medium voltage switchgear, medium voltage transformers, low voltage switchgear, generators, busduct, transfer switches, power distribution cabinets, and other critical electrical infrastructure.

The EPS team works to design and develop resilient, cost-effective electrical distribution products and systems. As an engineer at Amazon, they are responsible for achieving world class uptime for our customers. They drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs and communicate technical direction to senior leadership. They seek new ways to improve the reliability, scalability, and cost effectiveness of our engineering designs. As an engineer at Amazon, they have the opportunity to design, innovate, and improve the products our customers rely on.

Amazon offers a work environment where speed and quality matter. We continue to grow and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning. Amazon's work environment is unique in every aspect and offers a great opportunity for the right candidate.

If you have led or worked with high performing teams of engineers and enjoy working on complex problems, we want to hear from you. At Amazon, the successful candidate will be responsible for working on product designs and supporting our wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.

title: Finance Manager, Sub Same Day Supply Chain Finance, Sub Same Day Supply Chain Finance
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to own the financial strategy for a sub same day supply chain network from the ground up? Do you thrive in ambiguous, high-growth environments where you get to build the frameworks rather than inherit them? Do you want to be the finance leader who shapes how Amazon thinks about cost, routing, and investment for its fastest-scaling delivery program? If so, SSD Supply Chain Finance is looking for a Finance Manager with a record of achieving results.

The SSD Finance team owns the end-to-end cost architecture for Amazon's Same-Day Delivery network, the platform that ties together Amazon's biggest bets in Grocery, Drones, Ultra-Fast, and Robotics. This role will serve as the finance owner for the sub same day inbound supply chain, Amazon's fastest growing inbound freight and fulfillment program for general merchandise within the sub-same day network, managing lane-level transportation economics (cost per mile, utilization, total cost per unit), building cost models for new routing strategies, and partnering with Supply Chain and Operations leaders to drive the right investment decisions as the network scales.

The successful candidate will demonstrate an ability to influence business owners, support thoughtful decision-making, and adapt to a rapidly-evolving environment where the data infrastructure and planning frameworks are still being built. They will collaborate with stakeholders across Supply Chain, Operations, and Transportation, bring excellent verbal and written communication skills, and drive the highest-priority work forward in an environment where priorities shift weekly. A typical day in this role provides an opportunity to build financial models that directly inform network design decisions, partner with operations leaders on cost performance, and solve complex problems across inbound freight routing, carrier economics, and capacity planning that shape the future of Amazon's delivery network.

Key job responsibilities
• Owning the freight-in cost framework for the General Merchandise network, including lane-level cost per mile analysis, utilization tracking, and total cost per unit decomposition across Distribution Center to Same-Day Fulfillment Center, North American Customer Fulfillment to Same-Day Fulfillment Center, and 1DC to Same-Day Fulfillment Center lanes

• Building financial models and cost bridges for weekly and monthly business reviews that land on Director and Vice President desks, translating operational variances into actionable recommendations

• Partnering directly with Supply Chain and Operations leaders to validate routing assumptions, challenge capacity plans, and quantify trade-offs for network expansion decisions

• Identifying opportunities to reduce inbound transportation costs through data analysis, benchmarking key performance indicators, and developing new metrics where none exist today

• Contributing to planning cycles (Operating Plan, Quarterly Guidance) by building bottoms-up cost forecasts for a network that is actively scaling, requiring judgment calls on assumptions with limited historical data

• Implementing solutions to simplify, automate, and scale financial reporting processes, including contributing to AI-powered automation initiatives for Weekly Business Review reporting and entitlement tracking

- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

title: Sr: Migrations & Modernization SA, ASEAN
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Migration and Modernization Solutions Architect to join our ASEAN team, based in Singapore. This role sits at the intersection of enterprise migration & transformation, modern cloud architecture, and the rapidly evolving world of AI-driven workload modernization.

As a senior member of the ASEAN Migrations and Modernization SA team, you will lead enterprise customers through the full spectrum of transformation — from migrating legacy estates to AWS, to modernizing applications and architectures to become AI-ready, and ultimately enabling agentic AI deployments that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will advise on both dimensions of AI-era modernization: using AI to accelerate and automate migration and modernization programs at scale, and modernizing architectures so they are structurally capable of running and benefiting from AI and Agentic AI workloads.

You will work across the breadth of enterprise legacy environments - monolithic applications, commercial databases, VMware estates, and aging on-premises infrastructure — defining transformation pathways that are technically sound, commercially viable, and aligned to each customer's AI ambitions. You will collaborate closely with Migration and Modernization business development teams, partner development managers, and customer solution managers to drive revenue through successful migrations and modernizations across the region.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on architecture experience with a genuine passion for the emerging AI and agentic AI landscape. They understand that every modernization decision today is an AI enablement decision — and they are able to articulate this clearly to both technical and executive audiences. Strong judgment, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to operate effectively across diverse enterprise cultures in ASEAN are essential to success in this role.


Key job responsibilities
Migration Leadership
- Lead end-to-end cloud migration strategies for enterprise customers across ASEAN with hands-on technical depth — covering infrastructure, applications, databases, mainframes, and legacy on-premises estates — evaluating both technical feasibility and commercial viability of each program to drive successful outcomes on AWS.
- Build repeatable migration mechanisms, reference architectures, playbooks, and toolkits that systematically reduce time, cost, risk, and complexity for future engagements across the region.
- Drive deep adoption of AWS-native migration tooling — including AWS Transform (ATX), cloud assessment platforms, and agentic discovery tools including ISV tools — with the technical credibility to guide customers through real implementation challenges, compressing migration timelines from months to wee.
- Work with customers navigating complex multi-tower transformations: legacy application modernization, commercial software-to-open-source transitions, VMware exits, and large-scale data center consolidations.

Modernization and AI-Ready Architecture
- Design and deliver modernization architectures that move customers from monolithic, tightly coupled systems to decoupled, cloud-native, microservices-based architectures that are structurally ready for AI and Agentic AI workloads.
- Advise customers on the right modernization pathway for each workload — rehosting, replatforming, re-architecting, containerization, open-source migration, or managed database adoption — based on business value, complexity, and AI readiness impact.
- Articulate why every modernization decision is an AI enablement decision — helping customers understand that architecture choices made today directly determine what AI capabilities they can unlock tomorrow.
- Guide customers in building agentic-ready foundations: decoupled services, clean API and MCP interfaces, isolated data domains, independent deployment pipelines, and observable systems that support reliable autonomous AI agent operation.
- Identify and address AI-on-legacy failure patterns — context overload, hallucination risk, cascading failures, and latency amplification — that emerge when Agentic AI is deployed on unmodernized infrastructure, and define the modernization path that resolves them.

AI-Driven Modernization Delivery
- Champion the use of AI-powered tooling to execute migration and modernization programs — leveraging AWS Transform (ATX) for code transformation, automated dependency analysis, containerization, and continuous modernization at scale.
- Apply agentic assessment capabilities — including AI-driven discovery, automated portfolio analysis, and intelligent workload classification — to significantly compress the assessment and planning phases of enterprise transformation programs.
- Lead adoption of emerging standards and tooling in the agentic ecosystem — MCP, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, multi-agent orchestration patterns, and the Strands Agents SDK — as practical technical foundations for customer AI transformation programs.
- Help customers build and validate their Agentic AI Readiness posture, assessing current architecture across agent platform maturity, data and knowledge infrastructure, and operational governance.

Customer Engagement and Technical Advisory
- Customer Engagement and Technical Advisory
- Build trusted advisor relationships with CTO, CIO, and enterprise architect stakeholders — credible on both migration strategy and AI transformation roadmap.
- Lead hands-on discovery workshops, accelerator deliveries, architecture envisioning sessions, and multi-day modernization assessments; translate findings into prioritized transformation roadmaps with clear risk profiles and milestones.
- Articulate ROI, TCO, and business value to executive audiences; connect modernization investment directly to AI capability and competitive agility outcomes.
- Drive POCs through to completion and use outcomes to de-risk and accelerate broader program commitments.

Community, Enablement and Thought Leadership
- Capture and share best practices across the SA community; contribute to whitepapers, playbooks, and customer-facing guidance on migration, modernization, and AI-ready architecture.
- Develop and deliver workshops and enablement content for customers, partners, and internal teams — focused on agentic AI architecture patterns and AI-driven modernization tooling.
- Provide structured customer feedback to AWS product and engineering teams to influence the AWS Transform and migration toolset roadmap.
- Collaborate across AWS — services, marketing, professional services, partner development — to co-create GTM motions that accelerate customer transformation journeys.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Demonstrated experience leading architecture for large-scale public cloud migrations (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including multi-tower transformations programs.
- Hands-on experience with legacy application environments: monolithic architectures, mainframe systems, commercial databases, and aging on-premises infrastructure — and the modernization patterns that transform them.
- Broad architecture knowledge across: cloud migration, microservices, containers, serverless, relational and NoSQL databases, data engineering, networking, security, CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud-native infrastructure, experience with AI and Agentic AI concepts in an enterprise architecture context: multi-agent systems, LLM application patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, MCP-based integrations, and the infrastructure requirements for reliable autonomous AI operation.

Preferred qualifications

- AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Cloud Technology Certification
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, engineering or a related technical field, with 10+ years of experience architecting and delivering complex solutions for enterprise customers, including large-scale data center transformation and application migration programs.
- Hands-on experience with AWS Transform (ATX), or equivalent AI-driven modernization and migration acceleration platforms and tooling including ISV solutions for Migrations and Modernizations.
- Enterprise architecture background with demonstrated ability to build and articulate cloud-native and AI-ready technology roadmaps for large organizations.
- Experience operating across diverse ASEAN enterprise markets — with cultural sensitivity and adaptability, international enterprise customer experience with F500 organizations and global systems integrators or consulting partners.

title: Senior Product Manager, Buyability & Selection, Retail Operations and Initiatives
descriptionHtml:
Amazon South Africa is building out its Retail Operations and Initiatives function. This role owns the selection funnel: the path a product takes from being listed to being purchasable, discoverable, and delivered. Every friction point in that path is yours to find and fix. You will define the governance mechanisms, build the automation, and drive the cross-functional accountability that determines whether customers can buy what vendors make available. The model exists in peer markets; you are building it here from scratch with full ownership and direct visibility to country leadership.

Key job responsibilities
Own the end-to-end selection funnel and the weekly diagnostic that identifies where it leaks

Build the buyability defect taxonomy, the intake mechanism, and the triage SLAs from zero

Design and implement governance mechanisms for demand promise accuracy; migrate manual processes to automated, rules-based systems

Translate demand signals, competitive gaps, and funnel data into prioritised actions for Vendor Managers and In-Stock Managers

Partner with data engineering to build the intelligence layer that makes the funnel visible and actionable

Present funnel performance to store leadership; escalate blockers with clear business impact

Embed AI and automation into detection and governance workflows to scale without scaling headcount

A day in the life
Morning: the funnel. Conversion rates, defect queue, aged orders. You triage, escalate, and clear. Mid-morning: governance review with CS and In-Stock Management; you set the rules, they execute. Afternoon: deep in the data with your engineering partner, refining detection logic or reviewing a new dataset that just landed. Late afternoon: the vendor engagement loop; which products have demand but no supply, which suppliers need a nudge, what needs to change structurally. You close the day presenting the weekly diagnostic to leadership. No two days are the same. Most involve data, decisions, and moving something from blocked to buyable.

About the team
Retail Operations and Initiatives (RO&I) is the mechanism factory for Amazon South Africa. We build the scalable systems that remove operational friction from the retail pipeline, liberate commercial teams to focus on growth, and create the conditions for vendors to invest. The function is established in peer markets across Latin America, North America, and Europe. Small team, high ownership, zero tolerance for process debt. If you want to define how a marketplace operates rather than operate within someone else's definition, this is the role.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau, or experience using financial models, KPIs, and data analysis to inform business decisions with proven business impact (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
- Experience in e-commerce, retail or advertising, or experience in logistics
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights

- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

title: Fleet Operations Manager, Amazon Transportation Services
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) Mexico and help build our growing trailer fleet from the ground up. As a Fleet Operations Manager, you will own the daily tactical execution of Amazon's trailer fleet during a pivotal scaling phase; directly shaping fleet utilization, availability, cost-to-serve, and carrier performance. You will be the single point of contact for fleet operations: asset assignment, yard control, inspections, preventive maintenance, carrier coordination, and incident response. Working cross-functionally with First and Middle Mile site teams, Finance, and carrier partners, you will keep the fleet running reliably today while laying the operational foundation for the sites and regions we expand into tomorrow. This is a high-visibility, hands-on role where your execution and the data behind it inform decisions made at the most senior levels. This is your chance to help build and shape the future of our trailer fleet program from its earliest, most defining stage.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the weekly trailer assignment across sites and drive intra-week reassignments as demand shifts; making the calls that keep the network balanced under pressure.
- Run daily yard status reviews, classify fleet availability, and orchestrate relocations to maximize how hard every trailer works.
- Lead daily performance syncs with the carrier partner operating the fleet, setting the priorities and relocations for the day.
- Be the first responder for operational incidents and resolving within a increasing service level or escalating with a structured, decision-ready proposal.
- Coordinate pre-trip and post-trip inspections and drive preventive maintenance compliance to protect fleet uptime.
- Manage repair tickets end-to-end, tracking out-of-service units and return-to-service dates to minimize downtime.
- Build the daily operational reporting and clean datasets that leadership trusts to make scaling decisions.
- Design and tighten standard operating procedures for check-in/check-out and incident handling as the fleet grows into new sites and regions.

A day in the life
Your morning starts at the yard, one glance tells you which trailers are ready, which are stuck, and where the day's risks are hiding. You act before small problems become expensive ones. When a breakdown hits, the clock starts and you own it: coordinate the repair, keep the sites moving, resolve it fast. The rest of your day, you turn messy operations into the clear signals leaders trust to decide where we grow next. Every trailer you unblock sharpens how this fleet scales; from the sites we run today to the regions we're about to open. You help forge what comes next.

About the team
Amazon Transportation Services (ATS), a high-powered, dynamic team shaping middle-mile transportation execution and developing innovative concepts to enhance the ATS Network, now building and scaling Amazon's own trailer fleet in Mexico to drive the best customer experience, reliably and cost-efficiently, every time.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Last Mile BI
descriptionHtml:
When you attract people who have the DNA of pioneers and the DNA of explorers, you build a company of like-minded people who want to invent. And that’s what they think about when they get up in the morning: how are we going to work backwards from customers and build a great service or a great product” – Jeff Bezos
Amazon.com’s success is built on a foundation of customer obsession. Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like a clock work? In order to make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decision gets made by machines and humans. What is the accuracy of customer provided address? Do we know exact location of the address on Map? Is there a safe place? Can we make unattended delivery? Would signature be required? If the address is commercial property? Do we know open business hours of the address? What if customer is not home? Is there an alternate delivery address? Does customer have any special preference? What are other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day? Are we optimizing delivery associate’s route? Does delivery associate know locality well enough? Is there an access code to get inside building? And the list simply goes on. At the core of all of it lies quality of underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. The person in this role will be a strong influencer who will ensure goal alignment with Technology, Operations, and Finance teams. This role will serve as the face of the organization to global stakeholders. This position requires a results-oriented, high-energy, dynamic individual with both stamina and mental quickness to be able to work and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth global organization. Excellent communication skills and executive presence to get in front of VPs and SVPs across Amazon will be imperative.

Key Strategic Objectives: Amazon is seeking an experienced leader to own the vision for quality improvement through global address management programs. As a Business Intelligence Engineer of Amazon last mile quality team, you will be responsible for shaping the strategy and direction of customer-facing products that are core to the customer experience. As a key member of the last mile leadership team, you will continually raise the bar on both quality and performance. You will bring innovation, a strategic perspective, a passionate voice, and an ability to prioritize and execute on a fast-moving set of priorities, competitive pressures, and operational initiatives. You will partner closely with product and technology teams to define and build innovative and delightful experiences for customers. You must be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and have the ability to break complex problems down into steps that drive product development at Amazon speed. You will set the tempo for defect reduction through continuous improvement and drive accountability across multiple business units in order to deliver large scale high visibility/ high impact projects. You will lead by example to be just as passionate about operational performance and predictability as you will be about all other aspects of customer experience.

The successful candidate will be able to:
- Effectively manage customer expectations and resolve conflicts that balance client and company needs.

title: Cluster Service Technician , AMZL
descriptionHtml:
Summary

The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at Amazon is fundamental to our operations – they're the ones keeping vital machinery running at all times. As an RME Technician, you'll maintain a wide range of equipment and workspaces while upholding Health and Safety best practices. You'll help to keep your colleagues safe and prevent machine downtime. Our RME Technicians boost the availability and quality of our equipment and work to enhance the operational environment too.

Shift Pattern: This role includes working in non-traditional shift pattern, which may include nights and weekends



Key job responsibilities
- Proactive and preventative maintenance tasks on a wide range of site equipment
- Carry out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
- Use the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
- Uphold all health and safety policies and practices
- Support the development and progression of on-site apprentices
- Work on continuous improvement projects and roll out best practices across a range of EU sites


A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machinery issues. You'll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites' equipment to make sure it's working safely. As an RME Technician, you'll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding, and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You'll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.

Working alongside senior colleagues, you'll undertake day-to-day maintenance tasks and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You'll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we're known for.

As a Cluster Technician, you'll be assigned a nodal home site that serves as your primary base. However, the role includes an element of travel within your designated cluster of sites. This means you'll move between locations as needed to provide maintenance support, respond to breakdowns, and carry out planned preventative work across multiple facilities. This travel element ensures our sites receive consistent, high-quality technical coverage and gives you the opportunity to broaden your experience across a variety of operational environments.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

- Valid Full UK Driving License is Essential

Preferred qualifications

title: Manager, Software Development, AWS EC2 Nitro Operating System
descriptionHtml:
AWS EC2 Nitro powers the world's largest, fastest-growing, and most feature-rich compute cloud. Built from the ground up for virtualization at global scale, Nitro is a fully custom stack of hardware, firmware, and software that enables EC2 to support Intel, AMD, and AWS's own Graviton processors - while setting industry benchmarks for security and performance. With our Nitro System, we break apart traditional hypervisor functions like CPU virtualization, storage, and networking, and offload them to dedicated hardware and software. This enables us to deliver practically all of the resources of a server to customer instances, innovate faster, increase security, deliver new instance types, and reduce customer cost.

The Nitro Linux team owns the secure, embedded Linux environment at the heart of this system. We build and maintain the operating system that integrates with the Nitro control plane and powers live updates, metrics collection, core dump handling, and system health monitoring across AWS's global infrastructure. Linux, ash, C, lua, Rust - join us for embedded software systems at cloud scale!

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current Active Athletic Trainer Certification by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Supply Chain Business Insights
descriptionHtml:
Help shape the data foundation behind one of Amazon's fastest-growing supply chain networks — and put AI in the hands of the people who move millions of packages across Mexico every day. This is your chance to build the pipelines, analytics, and cloud-native solutions that turn raw data into trusted, accurate intelligence for an organization at the forefront of GenAI adoption.

As a Business Intelligence Engineer on the MX Supply Chain BI team, you will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, reporting solutions, and analytical tools that power decisions across Mexico's Supply Chain — from network planning and capacity to last mile operations. You will work with large-scale datasets on AWS, write production-grade Python code, deploy cloud-based solutions, and partner with stakeholders across 10 functional areas to deliver insights that drive operational performance. You will contribute to the team's AI-ready data lakehouse platform and help embed GenAI and ML capabilities into the analytics portfolio.

Key job responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/big-data pipelines using AWS services following medallion-architecture best practices

Write production-grade Python code for data transformation, automation, statistical analysis, and integration with AI/ML workflows

Build high quality datasets with robust metadata for agents to consume and give insights to our stakeholders.

Deploy and manage cloud-native data solutions on AWS through infrastructure-as-code based deployments.

Collaborate with stakeholders across Supply Chain functional areas (Topology, S&OP, Network Planning, Middle Mile, Last Mile, Sort Centers, Operations) to translate business questions into analytical solutions

Contribute to the team's AI-ready data lakehouse platform (Apache Iceberg on serverless AWS), ensuring data quality, governance, and single-source-of-truth standards

Write and optimize complex queries on SQL, Spark SQL and PySpark across large-scale datasets to support reporting, ad-hoc analysis, and metric development

Establish and follow engineering best practices including code reviews, testing, monitoring, documentation, and logging best practices.

Proactively identify opportunities to improve data availability, reduce time-to-insight, and automate manual reporting processes

Support the team's GenAI/ML initiatives by preparing governed, high-quality datasets and contributing to data products that enable agentic and self-service AI workflows

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing pipeline health dashboards and resolving any data quality alerts from overnight ETL runs. By mid-morning, you're deep in Python — building a new data transformation module. After a quick stand-up with your peers, you jump into a working session with a Last Mile stakeholder who needs a new metric added to their operational dashboard; you scope the requirement, write the code and push for your peers to review before lunch.

You wrap up the day by prototyping a data integration that will expose a new dataset to the team's GenAI agent through the MCP — a small step that will let operations leaders ask natural-language questions about network speed and compliance. No two days are the same, but every day your work makes Supply Chain decisions faster, smarter, and more trusted.

About the team


MX Supply Chain Business Insights owns the data, insights, and analytics that power how Amazon's Mexico Supply Chain organization understands its business, measures its customer experience, and makes decisions. The team serves 10 functional areas with growing cross-LATAM collaboration with Brazil.

Our team works together to deliver the data infrastructure, pipelines, semantic layers, and reporting that underpin MX Supply Chain's most critical business metrics, while also developing full stack applications to gather and process data. We are at an inflection point: as we embed GenAI across the portfolio and scale an AI-ready data lakehouse across LATAM, the decisions our stakeholders make depend on data they can trust, access quickly, and act on confidently.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- Experience using Python scripting to process data for modeling
- 3+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
- Experience using SQL (Structured Query Language) to pull data from a database or data warehouse
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Bachelor's degree or above in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with AI/ML technologies
- Experience building and operating a cloud-based architecture

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
- Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
- Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business
- Experience with forecasting and statistical analysis

title: Stagiaire Partenaire Ressources Humaines Opérations (6 Mois) - 2027
descriptionHtml:
Résumé du poste

L’énergie qui fait tourner le monde | Découvrez les carrières dans les Opérations

Les postes dans les Opérations chez Amazon vous placent au cœur de la façon dont les choses circulent, d’un simple clic jusqu’à la porte du client.
Vous contribuerez à concevoir, améliorer et faire fonctionner des systèmes qui relient les personnes, les produits et les lieux, à grande échelle. Vous prendrez des responsabilités dès le début, travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes pour résoudre des défis concrets, et verrez les résultats directs de vos décisions lorsqu’elles atteignent les clients chaque jour.
Ici, l’impact de ce que vous construisez n’est pas abstrait : il est visible, immédiat et significatif — il maintient en mouvement l’une des opérations les plus complexes au monde.
C’est ici que votre parcours prend forme, à travers l’action, la responsabilité et la possibilité d’évoluer dans de multiples directions.


Key job responsibilities
Principales responsabilités du poste

- Développer une connaissance approfondie des fonctions RH au sein des opérations dynamiques d’Amazon
- Participer aux efforts de communication interne afin d’aligner les équipes de plusieurs pays, en favorisant la collaboration et le partage d’informations
- Aider à élaborer des plans et des supports de formation répondant aux besoins de développement évolutifs des différentes équipes, afin de soutenir la croissance des collaborateurs et collaboratrices
- Découvrir les fonctions RH au sein de l’organisation Amazon au sens large et se tenir informé(e) des meilleures pratiques
- Apporter un soutien aux employé(e)s d’Amazon sur diverses questions quotidiennes liées à la présence, à l’engagement, à la rémunération et à d’autres sujets RH
- Assister les équipes RH dans les routines opérationnelles quotidiennes et les tâches administratives
- Participer à des revues de processus afin d’identifier des opportunités de simplification et d’automatisation, en améliorant l’efficacité
- Compiler des statistiques du personnel, des rapports et des évaluations de performance complets afin d’éclairer la prise de décision
- Collaborer étroitement avec les responsables opérationnel(le)s afin d’aligner les stratégies et initiatives RH sur les objectifs et priorités de l’organisation


A day in the life
Une journée type

Chaque journée est un peu différente en tant que Stagiaire Partenaire Ressources Humaines Opérations. Ce stage vous plongera dans les RH au sein d’une organisation mondiale, avec la possibilité de travailler sur des projets couvrant différents domaines RH — des relations sociales et de la formation à la rémunération et à l’analyse des effectifs. Vous pourriez passer votre matinée à analyser des données sur les effectifs afin d’identifier des tendances et de formuler des recommandations pour votre équipe, puis votre après-midi à accompagner un dossier de relations sociales ou à collaborer avec des responsables opérationnel(le)s sur une initiative de formation.
La fonction RH d’Amazon est profondément intégrée à l’activité ; ainsi, quel que soit le projet sur lequel vous travaillez, une partie de votre rôle consistera à utiliser les données et la réflexion analytique pour orienter les décisions. Vous appliquerez vos compétences en résolution de problèmes et vos compétences techniques à des défis concrets, tout en développant d’importantes compétences en communication et des compétences comportementales professionnelles grâce à une expérience pratique. Avec un(e) mentor(e) dédié(e) qui accompagnera votre développement tout au long du programme, vous découvrirez comment les RH s’associent à l’activité pour stimuler la croissance et l’excellence organisationnelle — offrant une base solide pour une carrière dans les ressources humaines.
Remarque : vous devez avoir le droit de travailler dans le pays d’emploi à la date de début.


About the team
À propos de l’équipe

Communauté des stagiaires :
En tant que stagiaire Amazon, vous ferez partie d’une communauté dynamique et bienveillante qui favorise votre croissance et votre développement. Vous collaborerez avec des stagiaires du monde entier, développerez votre réseau et participerez à des événements sociaux pour élargir vos perspectives. Vous pourrez également rejoindre des groupes spécialisés axés sur des thèmes tels que la durabilité, afin d’explorer vos centres d’intérêt variés.

Accompagnement :
Le programme de stage offre un solide dispositif d’accompagnement, comprenant des permanences hebdomadaires pour les stagiaires, un support informatique et RH dédié, ainsi qu’une équipe programme engagée dans votre réussite. Cela vous garantit l’encadrement et l’aide nécessaires pour vous épanouir.

Sessions d’apprentissage :
Des sessions d’apprentissage exclusives développeront encore vos compétences, en vous donnant accès aux plateformes d’apprentissage de pointe d’Amazon et à l’expertise de leaders du secteur. Ces opportunités de développement structurées vous prépareront à l’étape suivante de votre carrière.

Opportunités :
À l’issue réussie du stage, vous pourrez être considéré(e) pour un poste de jeune diplômé(e) ou un second stage, vous permettant de poursuivre votre parcours avec Amazon. De plus, vous bénéficierez d’un salaire mensuel compétitif, d’un soutien à la relocalisation et d’un accès à une gamme d’avantages réservés aux employés.

Dates de début des stages tout au long de l’année :
Nous recrutons des stagiaires pour un début à tout moment entre janvier et septembre 2027. Chaque mois, nous organiserons 1 à 2 journées d’intégration pour les nouveaux et nouvelles arrivant(e)s.

- Disponible pour un stage à temps plein (35 heures/semaine) et s'engager sur un stage de 6 mois
- Parler, écrire et lire couramment l'anglais et le français à un niveau C1 ou supérieur
- Obligatoire de pouvoir signer une convention de stage avec l'université de l'étudiant(e)

Preferred qualifications

- Excellentes compétences en communication et en travail d'équipe, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec diverses parties prenantes
- Curiosité, proactivité et volonté avérées d'apprendre et de se développer dans un environnement dynamique

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. title: Security Engineer-Pentest, Continuous Security Testing
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Security Engineer to join Continuous Security Testing (CST), the AWS team that thinks like an adversary against systems running in production. You will follow real-world signals to where testing matters most, work out what an adversary could do, and leave behind detections and tools that keep watch long after you've moved on.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the leading cloud provider. Businesses of every size, from start-ups to large enterprises, run their most sensitive workloads on it. As AWS grows, the surface we need to test grows faster than any team could keep up with by effort alone. CST meets that by pairing deep human expertise with signal-driven, AI assisted testing, so coverage grows with AWS rather than falling behind it.

We work from real world signals, such as threat intelligence and automated scanner output, to decide where testing will matter most. We steer AWS's most advanced AI tooling to hold the bar, then apply human judgement to raise it: imagining how an adversary might combine behaviours nobody thought to put together, adding the business and service context a model lacks, and designing the abuse cases that still need a person.

This is creative work. The most valuable things we find are the ones nobody knew existed: new techniques, novel attack paths and ideas that no checklist or scanner would ever suggest. We want engineers who love asking "what if?" and following the answer wherever it goes.

You will decide where to look, as well as test what you're given. You must produce results in ambiguity, follow a signal wherever it leads, and drive resolution with teams outside your own when a fix isn't simple. You will deliver independently, ask for guidance when a problem moves into unfamiliar territory, and say clearly when a line of investigation should stop.

Amazon's Leadership Principles of "Dive Deep", "Ownership", "Earn Trust" and "Invent and Simplify" will be called on daily.

Key job responsibilities
- Turn real world signals, threat intelligence, scanner output and past findings into testable hypotheses about how an adversary might think about systems in production
- Test live AWS services and internal systems, combining penetration testing with AI-augmented source code review, and direct the tooling at trust boundaries and attack paths it would not reach on its own
- Bring creativity to every investigation: invent new techniques and research areas nobody has explored yet
- Investigate whether something novel you've uncovered could apply across other systems, then prove or rule out impact end to end with safe, reproducible proof-of-concept work
- Trace attack paths across chained components to show compound risk that stays invisible when each component is tested alone
- Take each finding to a resolution: work with service teams, SecOps and AppSec on the fix, validate it, and check the fix can't be bypassed
- Turn what you find into lasting defences, such as detections that run across the fleet, security canaries, fuzzers and documented methods, and track whether other teams adopt them
- Build and tune the harnesses that steer the team's AI testing tools, measuring where they miss attack patterns or produce false positives
- Test agentic AI systems as an adversary would, including tool use, memory, agent-to-agent communication and orchestration
- Write clear results that record what you tested, why, what you found or ruled out, and the risk that remains
- Peer review other engineers' scopes and findings, and mentor engineers and apprentices on the team

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a cluster of real world signals that hint at something nobody has looked at yet. You form a hypothesis: if one system could be built this way, could others? You point the team's AI tooling at the source code to find candidates, then test the most promising ones by hand.

By the afternoon you've tested your hypothesis on one system and know exactly what an adversary could or couldn't reach. Now the question is scale. You write a query to see whether it could apply more widely, prove or rule out the worst cases safely, and agree priorities with SecOps and the service teams that own them.

Over the following weeks you stay with it. You review the proposed fix and check it can't be bypassed. You work with a detection team to turn your test into a check that runs across the fleet without you, so what you discovered keeps protecting AWS wherever it might appear.

In between, you review a peer's scope before their testing starts, help an apprentice through their first proof of concept, and share what you learned with the team so others can build on your idea.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores
Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.
Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques or equivalent
- Perform offensive testing of web applications and services, and source code review, to identify non-trivial issues
- Script your way out of problems and deploy code in an enterprise environment
- Experience with AWS technologies and services (e.g. S3, Lambda, EC2, KMS, IAM)
- Be data-driven and support your conclusions with evidence
- A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
- Experience in professional penetration testing, source code auditing, bug hunting, or CTF experience
- Demonstrable depth in at least two complex security domains such as identity and access management (IAM), web application and API security, networking, or workload and tenant isolation
- Experience finding security issues in multiple languages, including one or more of Java, Python, JavaScript, Rust, Ruby and C
- Experience in code development using Python or an equivalent language, including boto3

Preferred qualifications

- Experience turning a single finding into a campaign or detection across many systems
- Experience using AI tools or LLMs to scale security research, and judging where they fall short
- Experience working with threat intelligence or detection teams
- Experience performing or supporting Red Team engagements
- Experience running an initiative such as a CTF or an apprenticeship

title: Analytics Manager, Amazon News
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is hiring an experienced Analytics Manager for the Amazon News website (AboutAmazon.com) and email newsletter program. As an Analytics Manager you will be responsible for analyzing content and channel performance to unlock insights that drive strategic business decisions.

You will analyze performance and identify key metrics, support content creation, and make data-driven recommendations that help shape our editorial strategy. This role requires deep analytics knowledge, critical thinking and problem solving skills, understanding of website and email content strategies, and the ability to work cross-functionally with editorial, communications, and technical teams across a global organization. This person must also be able to partner with business leaders and be able to develop tactics to drive business goals, engagement, and reach. The ideal candidate is analytical, curious about AI, an effective storyteller, and thinks about content first — diving into data to identify content opportunities and translating insights into actionable editorial guidance.

This role is part of the Amazon News team, which sits within Amazon’s Communications & Corporate Responsibility org. Amazon News serves as the first and most trusted source of news and information about Amazon for external audiences. We help customers understand what Amazon is doing globally — from fostering a great workplace and driving innovation to supporting small business and sustainability. We tell the larger story of who Amazon is through compelling content on AboutAmazon.com and our off-platform distribution channels such as our email newsletter.

This is an individual contributor role based in New York, NY.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the reporting for the global Amazon News website and Amazon News email newsletter program.
• Develop weekly, monthly, and ad-hoc reports for Amazon News, including key performance metrics and insights tailored for leadership, peer teams, and communications partners.

• Translate key business questions related to audience, content, or channel into research and analysis, defining the sets of data required for each project.
• Counsel editorial team on how to tell a story with data and which metrics to prioritize.
• Work closely with editorial teams to develop and implement initiatives that maximize organic engagement for both new and evergreen stories.
• Use AI tools to accelerate and scale analytics work, such as building and automating dashboards, reporting, and other data workflows.

• Work cross-functionally with other analytics, reporting, and research teams to develop and share best practices and learnings, define and refine benchmarks, and develop best-in-class insights.
• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to implement scalable solutions, including data pipelines and data lake integrations, based on data insights from multiple sources and across multiple channels.
• Be resourceful and creative to overcome obstacles and turn challenges into opportunities.
• Stay current on industry trends, competitor techniques, AI developments, and best practices across data analytics.


About the team
Our team is focused on building products that make a meaningful difference for customers at Amazon scale. We operate in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where every team member has a voice in shaping what we build next. title: Principal PM-T, Growth, Outbound Communications
descriptionHtml:
Every day, hundreds of Amazon teams across Retail, Prime, Prime Video, Music, Alexa, and more reach customers through email, push, SMS, and messaging apps. Outbound Communications runs that marketplace, at the scale of hundreds of millions of customers and billions of messages, through everyday sending and Amazon's largest events: Prime Day, Prime Big Deal Days, and the holidays. Each message competes for finite customer attention. The marketplace grows when every message earns more of it: more customers open, click, and buy, and fewer opt out.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager - Technical to lead growth for this marketplace. You'll own click-through rate, conversion, and incremental sales per message across channels, and the technical products that move them: personalization and recommendations in messages, send-time and channel optimization, new creative and interactive experiences, conversational and messaging channels, and the experimentation engine that tells us what works.

You'll work backwards from the customer. You'll find where messages fail to earn engagement, form hypotheses, and run a high-velocity experimentation program with engineering and science. You'll ship the winners as platform capabilities that every sending team can use, not one-off campaign tweaks. You'll measure growth honestly, on clicks, conversions, incremental OPS, and long-term customer value, not opens, and you'll balance short-term lift against opt-outs and customer trust.



Key job responsibilities
- Own the growth strategy, roadmap, and goals for Outbound's customer attention marketplace: CTR, conversion, incremental OPS per message, and engagement across email, push, SMS, and messaging channels.
- Build and run a high-velocity experimentation program. Set the hypothesis backlog, prioritize by expected impact, and make A/B and multi-armed testing fast, trustworthy, and self-service for every sending team.
- Own the technical products that drive engagement: personalization and recommendations inside messages, send-time and channel selection, content and creative optimization, and interactive and conversational experiences that let customers act without leaving the message.
- Partner with science and engineering to bring ML and AI into who receives what, when, and on which channel, including ranking, propensity and uplift models, bandits, and generative content, and measure their incrementality against holdouts.
- Define the growth funnel and its instrumentation end to end, from delivered to opened, clicked, converted, and retained. Make the data reconcilable, real-time where it matters, and attributable to the module, content, and decision that drove it.
- Grow the addressable audience: opt-in and permission growth for new channels, reactivation of lapsed customers, and deliverability and reach improvements.
- Turn winning experiments into platform capabilities. Write PR/FAQs and requirements, make build-vs-buy and architecture trade-offs with engineering leaders, and drive adoption across partner teams.
- Set growth tenets and guardrails, such as opt-out, complaint, and frequency limits, so growth never comes at the cost of customer trust.
- Influence senior leaders across Retail, Prime, and partner businesses with data and written narratives, and report growth results and learnings in the Outbound business reviews.
- Raise the bar for growth and experimentation practice across Outbound, and mentor product managers.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience technical product management
- 10+ years of technical product or program management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
- Usage of generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency, with a willingness to learn effective prompting and evaluation practices
- Ability to recognize opportunities where generative AI could enhance products, workflows, or customer experiences

title: Product Manager Business Bulk Fulfilment, Amazon Business Operations - Analytics and Tech
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Business customers buy at a scale most retail systems were never built for: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking an entire floor. Today those orders often arrive as dozens of separate boxes over many days, and we are rebuilding how Amazon fulfills them.
You will own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment at Amazon Business. The goal is simple to state and hard to build: a customer places one large order, picks one date, and receives it once, in the form factor that fits their dock and their crew. Getting there means changing how Amazon sources, consolidates, packs and ships large orders, working shoulder to shoulder with the engineering teams that own fulfillment planning and fulfillment center operations. This is a builder role with a funded roadmap and direct exposure to senior leaders across Amazon Business, supply chain and operations.

Key job responsibilities
Own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment, from customer problem through launch and measured outcome.
Write the documents that get the work funded and built: PRFAQs, business requirements documents, and annual and three year planning inputs.
Act as the requirements owner with partner engineering teams in fulfillment planning and fulfillment center technology, not a ticket filer. Negotiate scope, sequence and dependencies directly with their product and engineering leaders.
Define how Amazon consolidates a large order into as few deliveries as possible, including palletized delivery and customer selected delivery dates.
Define how a request for many individual units can be served from cases and pallets of the same product, working through the inventory, receive and pick changes that requires.
Build the case for dedicated bulk fulfillment capacity, including moving product from suppliers to customers without a putaway step.
Replace manual operator work with automation across sourcing, consolidation and promise, and track the reduction.
Own the metrics: deliveries per order, delivery date accuracy, ship cost per unit and contribution profit per unit. Pull your own data and defend your own numbers.

A day in the life
You will spend your day between customers and builders. Mornings often start in the data, checking how last week's large orders actually shipped and where they fragmented. From there it is working sessions with fulfillment planning and fulfillment center engineering teams on requirements, a review with operations leaders on the manual work still left in the flow, and time with Amazon Business sales and customer teams on what large buyers are asking for. You will write often, and you will present what you write to directors and above.

About the team
Amazon Business (AB) launched in the United States in April 2015 with the vision of delivering a comprehensive procurement solution for business customers of all sizes. In the US, AB now serves Fortune 500 companies, hospital systems, local governments, and education organizations. To support AB's mission, the AB Operations team owns end to end customer experience for AB customers right from checkout to final mile delivery and sits under the broader Global Transportation Services (GTS). We are the Single Threaded WW Ops team driving B2B operations, developing products and programs unique to business customers, and enhancing the business delivery capabilities.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of product management experience
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building and analyzing cost/benefit scenarios and business cases and communicating results throughout the organization
- Experience working with technical and product stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, and influence product roadmaps

As a rapidly growing $50 billion global business, we're building a future where businesses of all sizes can find, discover, and purchase everything they need with unprecedented ease and intelligence. Our mission: to become the world's most customer-centric company and the preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. From solo entrepreneurs to Fortune 500 companies, we serve diverse business customers across eleven countries, reimagining procurement with innovative solutions that drive efficiency and growth.
