The Role:
Are you excited about building products that transform how millions of businesses discover and adopt e-commerce?
Amazon Business India is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India.

The Vision: We believe the next frontier in B2B commerce is moving from generic experiences to deeply personalized ones. Unlike B2C, Amazon Business customers register with verified business identifiers (GST, PAN), giving us rich context — industry, company size, purchase patterns — from Day 1. We intend to leverage this unique B2B advantage to deliver smarter, more relevant experiences across every customer touchpoint, both onsite and offsite.

We are seeking a talented Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India. This is a dual-mandate role spanning two interconnected domains:

1. Onsite Shopping Experience: You will re-imagine every aspect of the business customer's onsite journey — browse, search, selection and offer discovery and checkout. The objective is to simplify the end-to-end shopping experience with personalization and friction reduction to increase frequency and basket size of business customer purchases. You will create a north-star experience that enables customers to quickly discover the most relevant product or high-value action, and complete their purchase with the fewest steps possible.

2. Off-App Marketing Tech: You will own the marketing technology stack that powers automated, personalized outbound engagement across every customer touchpoint off-app, including:
- Organic & AI surfaces — traditional search (SEO) and emerging AI platforms
- Conversational surfaces — WhatsApp and chat-based engagement
- Outbound channels — email and push notifications
- Amazon.com and social — on-platform and social media surfaces

You will build and scale the systems and tooling that enable marketers to create, test, and optimize customer lifecycle journeys without engineering dependency — driving high-intent engagement back into the Amazon Business app and strengthening the brand across off-app surfaces.

Key job responsibilities

- Vision & Strategy: Define the long-term product vision and roadmap for both onsite shopping experience and off-app marketing tech — creating a unified engagement layer across all customer touchpoints
- Personalization: Drive the development of personalization capabilities that leverage business context and behavioral signals to deliver relevant experiences across onsite and offsite channels
- Customer Understanding: Develop deep understanding of business customer lifecycle patterns, procurement behaviors, and channel preferences to inform when, where, and how we engage customers
- Experience Design: Design and implement customer experiences that are contextual, frictionless, and consistent across the onsite journey and outbound channels
- Marketing Automation: Build and scale marketing automation systems that enable personalized, multi-channel customer journeys — from acquisition through retention — with self-serve tooling for marketing team
- Innovation: Pioneer new approaches to B2B customer engagement across emerging surfaces including AI platforms, conversational interfaces, and agentic experiences — positioning Amazon Business ahead of shifting customer behavior
- Metrics & Experimentation: Define success metrics, build a robust experimentation roadmap, and drive continuous optimization across all channels and lifecycle stages
- Collaboration: The roadmap will be a mix of India-first products and India adaptations of global product features. You will partner closely with senior stakeholders across engineering, science, marketing, UX design, and business intelligence teams across Amazon India and Amazon Worldwide


A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing key product metrics and customer feedback, identifying signals that inform your next set of priorities. By mid-morning you are in a design review, debating trade-offs on a new feature with your engineering and design partners. After lunch you draft a product requirements document, pressure-testing assumptions with data from recent experiments. title: Commissioning Engineer, AWS Commissioning, AMER-West
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning and looking for a fast paced environment to work in? As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems

Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
Work in a noisy environment
Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Job Requirements
· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Hold a US passport or have the ability to acquire one.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.

U.S Citizenship Required

Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and short timelines.

A day in the life
On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. The CxE manages the project commissioning vendor whose primary scope is to identify issues, determine criticality, propose solutions, and document their findings. If project turnover is at risk, the CxE escalates to the appropriate stakeholders. Upon project completion, the CxE will communicate lessons learned to help peers on similar projects in flight and participate in initiatives that drive improvement to the commissioning program.

About the team
The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCGS organization. This team of veteran professional Electrical Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Controls Engineers, Architectural Engineers, Project Managers, Operators and seasoned Amazonians are uniquely positioned to provide deeply detailed engineering and operational review and testing of equipment designs, operational functionality and construction practices. We are focused on ensuring the rapid delivery of a quality product while maintaining full transparency, recording metrics of manufacturer/contractor/equipment issues pre-PFHO, and identifying opportunities for all our peers and customers.

title: Sr. Risk Manager, Regulatory Intelligence Safety and Compliance (RISC)
descriptionHtml:
Do you enjoy designing and implementing solutions to ambiguous and complex problems? Are you looking to expand your scope of impact and influence strategic decision making? Are you in the market for a new, exciting challenge where you are empowered to use your ingenuity to innovate? If so, we are looking for talented people like you to join our Regulatory, Intelligence, Safety and Compliance (RISC) solution delivery team.

The RISC team's charter is to protect Amazon customers from products that are illegal, illegally marketed, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited by Amazon policies. In this role, you will work closely with legal, business teams, selling partner experience and support teams, operational excellence, product, BI and data science/engineering teams to deliver high-impact end-to-end safety and compliance solutions. Think of this role as a non-technical "solution architect" where you will be given autonomy to develop a strategy and build effective policy enforcements to ensure product safety and compliance worldwide.

The Senior Risk Manager drives the development and implementation of new tools and programs that advance the store's global safety and compliance efforts. This role requires influencing cross-functional stakeholders, planning strategic projects with legal and business partners, securing team commitments, and developing daily, weekly, and monthly metrics while ensuring compliance with Amazon quality standards and regulatory program expectations.

Key job responsibilities
• Drive Cross-Functional Programs: Own and deliver complex, cross-cutting initiatives by partnering with legal, business, tech, and operational excellence teams—bringing structure and momentum to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder efforts.
• Influence Without Authority: Build trusted relationships across multiple organizations; align diverse stakeholders around shared goals, secure commitments, and drive decisions forward—even when you don't own the teams doing the work.
• Build the Mechanisms That Keep Us Sharp: Design and run the operating cadences (business reviews, launch readiness checkpoints, intake processes) that ensure our safety and compliance controls launch with quality and consistency every time.
• Own the Metrics That Matter: Define, develop, and maintain the daily, weekly, and monthly performance metrics that give the team and leadership clear visibility into what's working, what's not, and where to focus next.
• Find the Friction and Fix It: Identify bottlenecks, eliminate redundant work, and drive automation opportunities that free up risk managers to focus on the high-judgment, high-impact work they do best.
• Raise the Quality Bar: Establish and maintain standards for control launches and program deliverables, ensuring every enforcement we ship meets Amazon's quality expectations and regulatory requirements.
• Turn Strategy into Action: Partner with leadership to translate business priorities and legal requirements into clear project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, and timelines that teams can actually execute against.
• Build Tools and Frameworks That Scale: Champion the development of new tools, templates, and repeatable playbooks that accelerate the team's ability to launch safety and compliance programs worldwide.
• Write with Clarity and Purpose: Author crisp, well-structured documents—SOPs, program updates, leadership narratives—that make complex information accessible and drive informed decision-making.
• Be the Operational Backbone: Keep the trains running. Maintain visibility across workstreams, remove blockers, track commitments, and create the organizational structure that makes everyone on the team more effective at their jobs.

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in compliance, audit or risk management
- Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
- Experience developing and implementing of standards, policies and programs or equivalent
- Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion
- Experience in program or project management

Preferred qualifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Master's degree or equivalent

title: Data Engineer, Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about sustainability and waste reduction efforts across Amazon's global organization? Are you interested in building the data foundation that drives solutions balancing packaging and automation to increase speed, reduce cost, and ultimately delight our customers? The Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation team is looking for a Data Engineer to join us in building and maintaining the end-to-end data pipelines and infrastructure that power our analytics and business decisions. This is your opportunity to be a core part of the team that reduces waste for our business and our customers.

In this role, you will design, build, and operate the data pipelines behind our "source of truth" data store and metrics for warehouse automation and customer packaging. You will develop robust, scalable ETL/ELT solutions that integrate large, complex data spanning many sources and data structures using AWS tools, enabling data-driven decisions on OEE, machine metrics, and product performance across our packaging automation, IB sortation, and other warehouse automation products.

We are looking for a builder with deep SQL proficiency, strong Python skills, and knowledge of data modeling and warehousing best practices. You will apply rigorous data quality and data security practices, including validation, deduplication, PII handling, access controls, and monitoring, so that stakeholders can trust the data and sensitive operational data stays protected as it moves through our pipelines. You'll partner closely with Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Scientists, Product, and Operations to translate raw data into reliable, well-governed datasets and actionable insights.

The ideal candidate thrives amid ambiguity, builds for the future while delivering today, and understands the importance of code development best practices. If you love hard problems with many solutions and a diverse, results-oriented environment, come join us!



Key job responsibilities
• Be hands-on with ETL/ELT to build and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines using SQL, Python, and Spark that support automated reporting for warehouse automation and customer packaging
• Interface with other technology teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of sources spanning warehouse automation and customer packaging
• Implement data structures using best practices in data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, SQL, and Redshift, and manage our "source of truth" data stores
• Implement best practices in batch and real-time data processing to make pipelines performant
• Apply strong data quality practices (validation, deduplication, PII handling, drift detection, and monitoring) so consumers can trust the data
• Build data security and access controls into the data infrastructure, protecting sensitive operational and performance data throughout its lifecycle
• Model data and metadata for ad-hoc and pre-built reporting, and deliver high-quality datasets to support BIEs, Data Scientists, and customer reporting needs
• Manage and optimize cloud computing resources on AWS to support data infrastructure
• Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Amazon Q, Kiro) to accelerate pipeline development, SQL, and debugging, while validating generated output for correctness
• Create extensible, easy-to-maintain designs with a long-term vision, laying groundwork to support future machine learning and GenAI use cases
• Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions


A day in the life
As a Data Engineer on this team, you will own the end-to-end data pipelines and infrastructure that serve as our "source of truth" for warehouse automation and customer packaging metrics. You will design, build, and operate robust and scalable ETL/ELT solutions, integrating complex data from dozens of sources to enable data-driven decisions across the Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation Organization.
You will partner closely with Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Operations teams to translate raw requirements into reliable and scalable data pipelines producing datasets that can be used and trusted across the org. You will also champion data quality and security practices, ensuring stakeholders can trust the data while sensitive operational information stays protected throughout its lifecycle.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of data engineering experience
- 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics
- Knowledge of distributed systems as it pertains to data storage and computing
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala)
- Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
- Experience with any ETL tool like, Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI, Datastage, etc.

title: Software Development Engineer, Customer Experience Improvement - Defect Enrichment
descriptionHtml:
We see our customers as invited guests to a party, and we are the hosts. It's our job every day to make every important aspect of the customer experience a little bit better." - Jeff Bezos, Founder & CEO

We didn’t make Amazon a trillion-dollar company, our customers did, and we want to ensure that our customers always have a positive experience that keeps them coming back to Amazon. To help achieve this, the Customer Experience Improvement (CXI) team, within Amazon Customer Service (CS), relentlessly focuses on maintaining customer trust by building products that offer appropriate resolutions to resolve issues faced by our customers. CXI engineers solve complex problems and build scalable, robust solutions to help our customers navigate through issues and eliminate systemic defects to prevent future issues and identify critical customer experience improvement opportunities. This role will leverage latest technologies and Agentic AI solutions to autonomously eliminate defects at scale to improve customer experience.


Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and own scalable solutions that empower Amazon to deliver a defect-free experience for customers.
- Build intuitive tools for Customer Service Associates (CSAs) to escalate critical issues, and develop complex integrations with Tier-1 Amazon systems and advanced science models to detect, triage, and resolve systemic defects.
- Tackle complex technical challenges, create innovative solutions with direct impact on customer trust, and work on systems critical to Amazon's operational excellence.

About the team
ARCADE (Automated Root Causing, Attribution and Defect Elimination) is the Defect Elimination system within CXI Tech, manifesting Amazon's commitment to preventing customers from receiving defective products that degrade their experience. ARCADE leverages AI to transform how we detect repeat negative customer experiences and eliminate the underlying upstream defects at scale. The CXI Tech team re-imagines how we leverage customer interactions and feedback — through modular capabilities spanning Detection, Triage, Root Cause, Attribution, and Resolution — to enable more reliable and faster defect elimination that drives customer experience improvements throughout the consumer business. The system combines associate-driven signals (empowering front-line CSAs to flag product problems) with statistical and machine learning-based automated detection, intelligent prioritization, and increasingly autonomous investigation through our agentic ecosystem. ARCADE serves multiple tenants including Andon Cords (high-severity defects) and customer service quality, providing a unified, scalable approach to defect elimination across Amazon.

- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

title: Sr. RF Test Systems Development Engineer, Avionics Verification and Test, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

As an Amazon Leo Sr. Satellite RF Test Systems Development Engineer, you will own the full lifecycle of complex RF test systems for spacecraft avionics and payload sub-systems — from architecture and design through production integration and post-delivery support. You will serve as the Responsible Engineer (RE) for your test set, operating at the intersection of hardware design, test automation, and high-rate space flight manufacturing. You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. You'll have relentlessly high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and you'll be constantly looking for ways to improve. We want individuals who want to reach beyond what is possible today. Everyone on the team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats, and work in a highly collaborative environment.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Architect, design, build, and sustain RF test systems for satellite payload and avionics units through design validation testing, space qualification testing, production acceptance testing, and on-orbit support
• Own test planning end-to-end: decompose verification requirements into testable specifications, develop test procedures, and lead test readiness reviews
• Drive cross-functional alignment with electrical, mechanical, thermal, software, firmware, and manufacturing teams on verification strategy
• Design and deliver space flight test hardware, fixtures, and tooling that optimize throughput, yield, and fault coverage
• Build quantitative models (test coverage, reliability, throughput) to inform design trade studies and process decisions
• Automate and optimize test processes to meet production rate and first-pass yield targets
• Perform root cause analysis on test failures, lead corrective actions, and drive continuous improvement of production test systems


A day in the life
Our time is balanced between critical support/improvement of an existing factory spaceflight test process and designing future systems. This can be hands-on support troubleshooting test systems or working to align teams around future needs, employing engineering best practices and tools.

The tasks and daily focus change rapidly, and you will often take on exciting new responsibilities to ensure project success. Expect to address complex problems by diving deep into the data, identifying the scope of the issue, and creating innovative and functional solutions.


About the team
This Interdisciplinary Engineer will be a member of the Avionics Verification & Test team working within the wider Satellite RF Hardware Engineering team. This highly collaborative group of engineers has a diverse range of backgrounds and knowledge and works to build scalable and reliable test automation solutions to ensure reliable operation of satellite vehicles in space. The team's responsibilities include design of space payload LRUs: modems, transceivers, LNBs, BUCs and front end modules, process development, test hardware and software development, and test execution supporting our 24/7 high rate satellite manufacturing factory.

title: Senior Systems Development Engineer, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC)
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

Would you like to implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve the world's most complex technical problems? Do you have a deep passion and desire to engineer and operate the world's largest cloud computing infrastructure to build a better world for future generations?

This is an exciting opportunity to use the latest cloud computing technologies to help U.S. Government agencies implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve technical problems.

AWS established a specialized group of service teams responsible for the work we are doing with the U.S. Intelligence Community. We are building some of the largest and most complex distributed systems in the world, and we need adaptable people to help us implement and operate them.

The Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) Networking team is seeking highly motivated engineers who are focused on operational excellence, troubleshooting complex system operations, have a good understanding of Linux, networking, and general knowledge of cloud services. We're also looking for engineers who can use their software knowledge to automate the way we manage and scale our services. We need engineers who understand how to think big, and simplify solutions to complex problems; all the while ensuring that our customers continue to have the best experience possible.

You will be able to take a defined project, break down the work to help define milestones and feedback mechanisms. You identify when implementations are not highly available or have defects; you investigate systemic patterns. You resolve, mitigate, or escalate operational concerns in a timely manner.

The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
You'll own the software services and platforms that keep the AWS network running within the region — and you'll lead the engineering effort to continuously reinvent them to be more resilient, more automated, and more scalable.

Your dual mandate — operational excellence today and engineering innovation for tomorrow — means no two weeks look the same. You'll own the health and reliability of critical network software systems, responding to operational events with the calm precision of someone who understands the architecture end-to-end. But you won't stop at firefighting. You'll identify patterns in operational burden and engineer them away, building automation that transforms manual runbooks into self-healing workflows.

Your engineering work spans the full lifecycle of complex distributed systems. You'll lead the design and implementation of solutions that reduce operational toil at scale, develop automation that minimizes human intervention, and collaborate with global service teams to enhance stability and functionality. You'll design and implement entirely new software components, products, and services that improve operational efficiency on behalf of your network engineer customers.

When technical issues arise, you'll lead the investigation — diagnosing at the code or systems level, performing root cause analysis, implementing long-term fixes, and articulating technical requirements back to service owners with clarity and precision. When incidents arise, you'll lead with clarity and purpose. When the dust settles, you'll lead the retrospective that ensures the same issue never surfaces again.

You'll mentor fellow engineers, guiding them through operational deep-dives and passing on the craft of systems thinking. You'll contribute to architectural decisions that shape the programme's future, champion best practices that raise the bar for the entire team, and build the relationships with global service teams that ensure successful deployments and effective problem resolution.

You will:

- Lead projects to disambiguate and solve challenging distributed systems problems on a global scale.
- Develop best in class software systems for automating Amazon's network.
- Be responsible for the design, implementation, and quality of services you deliver.
- Learn, design, and build cloud-computing systems for a diverse set of customers and contribute to documentation of process and procedures.
- Use and develop tools and processes that collect & rationalize data from different sources and frameworks to reduce workloads.
- Use data to measure success and take responsibility for the quality of your service and, regardless of their source; Strive to prevent faults from impacting your customers.
- Be a leader on an agile team, independently drive challenging projects and milestones to completion.
- Work closely with our Network Engineering teams to ensure fast and smooth software roll-outs and design and recommend optimization for service delivery and fleets.


A day in the life
You will be a technical leader on a team that shapes the automation future in networking. You will lead development of new key services and partner with stakeholders across the organization to improve networking security and availability posture in ADC Regions. You will play a leading role by interacting with customers, gathering requirements, then influencing how we design, develop, build, deploy, and support new features and functionality.

You will collaborate with Senior Engineers with deep knowledge in network architecture. You will have the opportunity expand your horizons, mentoring engineers across the organization and expanding your influence as a technical leader. With an open-minded team such as ours, you will have an eager-to-learn unit of peers with whom you get to grow mutually.

About the team
AWS Amazon Dedicated Cloud Networking owns datacenter network services that provide unconstrained connectivity to dedicated US Government customers. They own the networks end to end, including scaling, design, and operational functions.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

- 6+ years of deploying and operating in a Linux/Unix environment experience
- 6+ years of systems development in an IT or data center environment experience
- 3+ years of systems design, software development, operations, automation, and process improvement experience

title: ML Compiler Engineer, Neuron Kernel Interface
descriptionHtml:
AWS Machine Learning accelerators are at the forefront of AWS innovation. Trainium delivers best-in-class ML training performance with the most teraflops (TFLOPS) of compute power for ML in the cloud. This is all enabled by the AWS Neuron Software Development Kit (SDK), which includes an ML compiler, the Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) compiler, and a runtime that natively integrates into popular ML frameworks such as PyTorch and JAX.

Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) is a bare-metal language and compiler for directly programming AWS Trainium instances. You can use NKI to develop, optimize, and run new operators directly on hardware while making full use of available compute and memory resources.

Explore NKI:
- https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/index.html

AWS Neuron is used at scale by customers such as Epic Games, Snap, Airbnb, Autodesk, Amazon Alexa, and Amazon Rekognition, along with many others across a range of segments.

Amazon's Annapurna Labs is responsible for building innovative silicon and software for AWS customers. We are at the forefront of innovation, combining cloud scale with the world's most talented engineers. Our team covers multiple disciplines including silicon engineering, hardware design and verification, software, and operations. With such breadth of talent, there is opportunity to learn all the time. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. When you couple that with the ability to work on so many different products and services, it makes for a unique learning culture.

Learn more about our history:
- https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-success

Explore the Product:
- https://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/

As an ML Compiler Engineer with the Annapurna Neuron team, you develop and scale compilers to handle the world's largest ML workloads on AWS Trainium. You design and ship features across the compiler stack, work directly with Amazon ML partner teams to unblock their workloads, and grow your skills alongside senior engineers. You want to work close to the hardware, help bring new products and features to market, and ship high-quality code.

A background in Machine Learning, AI accelerators, or Kernel performance is helpful, but not required.

In order to be considered for this role, candidates must be located near or willing to relocate to Seattle or Cupertino.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build compiler features for the Neuron compilers. Your work may span the frontend, intermediate representations, optimization passes, and code generation for the hardware.
- Own features from design through production: design, implement, test on hardware and simulation, and support customers.
- Work with Amazon ML teams (PyTorch, JAX, and internal model teams) to understand their workloads and unblock them.
- Give hardware teams compiler and programmability feedback on upcoming chips.
- Review code and designs, and mentor newer engineers.

A day in the life
You start the day reviewing a teammate's code for a new compiler feature, leaving feedback before it merges. Mid-morning, you work with a model team whose kernel isn't reaching peak performance on Trainium, and you trace the bottleneck through the compiler's passes. After lunch, you write and test the feature you designed last week, then run it on hardware to confirm correctness. The team moves quickly and you are always in the details.

About the team
We are the compiler teams behind AWS Neuron, the software that runs machine learning models on Amazon Trainium. Our ML compiler takes a full model from PyTorch or JAX and compiles the graph to run across the chip. The Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) is a bare-metal language and compiler that lets customers program Trainium directly, down to the compute and memory, for a new operator or a faster kernel. Together we own the path from framework model to silicon. Our mission is to make Trainium fast and fully programmable.

Our teams are small and agile, and there is opportunity to learn all the time. We work closely with the hardware, runtime and framework teams, and with the Amazon ML teams who use our compilers.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Technicien(e) Data Center, Data Center Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) recherche des personnes passionnées par les technologies pour rejoindre notre équipe en tant que Technicien(e) Data Center.

Vous contribuerez à l'installation, la maintenance et l'optimisation des équipements de nos centres de données : serveurs, équipements réseau et stockage. Vous serez également amené(e) à participer à la formation et au mentorat de nouveaux membres de l'équipe, ainsi qu'au processus de recrutement.

AWS Infrastructure Services est responsable de la conception, de la planification, de la livraison et de l'exploitation de l'ensemble de l'infrastructure mondiale d'AWS. En d'autres termes, nous sommes les personnes qui font fonctionner le cloud. Nous assurons le support de tous les centres de données AWS ainsi que de l'ensemble des serveurs, du stockage, des équipements réseau, de l'alimentation électrique et des systèmes de refroidissement qui garantissent à nos clients un accès continu à l'innovation sur laquelle ils comptent. Nous travaillons sur les problèmes les plus complexes, avec des milliers de variables impactant la chaîne d'approvisionnement — et nous recherchons des personnes talentueuses qui souhaitent contribuer.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe diversifiée composée d'ingénieur(e)s logiciel, matériel et réseau, de spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, d'expert(e)s en sécurité, de responsables des opérations et d'autres rôles essentiels. Vous collaborerez avec des collègues à travers AWS pour nous aider à offrir les plus hauts standards de sécurité et de fiabilité, tout en fournissant une capacité quasi illimitée au coût le plus bas possible pour nos clients. Vous découvrirez une culture inclusive qui accueille les idées audacieuses et vous donne les moyens de les mener à bien.

Merci de nous transmettre votre CV en anglais. Seule la partie technique de l'entretien sera conduite en anglais.


Key job responsibilities
• Préparer et installer les équipements IT du centre de données (racks, serveurs, réseaux)
• Assurer la maintenance préventive et curative des équipements : serveurs, commutateurs et routeurs
• Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes d'alimentation et les incidents physiques sur les racks
• Participer à la gestion des événements liés aux pertes de refroidissement ou d'alimentation du centre de données
• Gérer et traiter les demandes de support client via un système de tickets
• Gérer le décommissionnement et le recyclage des équipements
• Participer à des réunions, à l'analyse de données et au suivi de projets transversaux à fort impact
• Collaborer étroitement avec les fournisseurs d'infrastructures
• Renforcer les bonnes pratiques de sécurité d'AWS
• Gérer et optimiser les stocks de pièces de rechange
• Participer aux rotations d'astreinte des sites


A day in the life
En tant que Technicien(e) Data Center, votre journée sera variée et stimulante. Vous commencerez par consulter les tickets de support et prioriser les interventions du jour. Vous pourrez être amené(e) à installer de nouveaux serveurs dans les racks, diagnostiquer une panne réseau ou effectuer une maintenance préventive sur des équipements critiques.

Vous travaillerez au cœur de nos infrastructures, en collaboration avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires — ingénieur(e)s réseau, responsables des opérations et fournisseurs. Chaque jour apporte de nouveaux défis techniques qui vous permettront de développer vos compétences et d'avoir un impact direct sur la fiabilité des services AWS utilisés par des millions de clients dans le monde.

Vous participerez également au mentorat de collègues et à des projets d'amélioration continue, contribuant ainsi à l'évolution de nos pratiques et de notre équipe.


About the team
Pourquoi AWS ?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) est la plateforme cloud la plus complète et la plus largement adoptée au monde. Nous avons été pionniers du cloud computing et n'avons jamais cessé d'innover — c'est pourquoi des clients allant des startups les plus prometteuses aux entreprises du Global 500 font confiance à notre gamme complète de produits et services pour alimenter leurs activités.

Expériences diversifiées
Chez AWS, nous valorisons la diversité des parcours. Même si vous ne remplissez pas toutes les qualifications souhaitées mentionnées dans cette offre, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Que votre carrière débute, qu'elle ait suivi un parcours non traditionnel ou qu'elle inclue des expériences atypiques, n'hésitez pas à candidater.

Une culture d'équipe inclusive
Chez AWS, la curiosité et l'apprentissage font partie de notre ADN. Nos groupes d'affinité, portés par nos collaborateurs et collaboratrices, favorisent une culture d'inclusion qui nous permet d'être fier(e)s de nos différences. Des événements et des expériences d'apprentissage continus, notamment nos conférences Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) et AmazeCon (diversité de genre), nous inspirent à célébrer notre singularité.

Mentorat et évolution de carrière
Nous relevons continuellement nos standards pour devenir le meilleur employeur au monde. C'est pourquoi vous trouverez ici d'innombrables ressources de partage de connaissances, de mentorat et de développement professionnel pour vous aider à évoluer et à vous épanouir.

Équilibre vie professionnelle / vie personnelle
Nous valorisons l'harmonie entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. La réussite au travail ne doit jamais se faire au détriment de votre vie personnelle. C'est pourquoi nous favorisons la flexibilité dans notre culture de travail. Quand nous nous sentons soutenu(e)s au travail comme à la maison, il n'y a rien que nous ne puissions accomplir.

- Formation Bac+2 en informatique (BTS, DUT, ou formation équivalente)

title: Software Development Manager, AWS Elastic Load Balancing
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help lead the cloud revolution and build software that thrives at immense scale?

AWS Elastic Load Balancing(ELB) enables customers to build large scale highly available services. ELB automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets, such as Amazon EC2 instances, containers, IP addresses, and Lambda functions. ELB provides the entry point for building hyper scale, fault tolerant applications. While ELB has seen tremendous growth since launch we are still in the early stages of realizing our full potential.

As a Software Development Manager for the Network Load Balancer (NLB) and Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) control plane team, you will be responsible for leading a group of talented engineers in the ongoing mission to empower ELB Control Plane and ELB Customers to react quickly and accurately on ELB runtime dynamics. We are doing so by building an array of micro-services that process extremely large volume of raw, partial and transitory data collected by ELB Data Plane instruments, and transform such data into valuable information and insights, which can be easily utilized by ELB Control Plane as well as ELB customers to make critical runtime system adjustments. We grow with our customers, and you will be leading to make that a reality. You will have an opportunity to effect change and impact for all of AWS. This is an exciting problem space that is just getting started.

A successful candidate is experienced in leading a team of deeply technical engineers. You, the candidate, must have proven skills as a leader that delivers on business objectives, prioritizes work, and influences partner teams. You will establish goals for your team and focus attention on the most important inputs to drive the desired business outcomes. You know how to grow the team by hiring, investing in people, and developing talent from within. ELB operates at large scale and enables customers to build high availability systems world-wide, so a passion and discipline around operational excellence is key. Come help us make history with ELB.

- Lead and manage a team of software engineers building and operating AWS Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) services at massive scale
- Drive technical strategy, architecture decisions, and roadmap planning for ELB features and reliability improvements

- Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement aligned with Amazon's Leadership Principles


About the team
AWS Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) automatically distributes incoming traffic across multiple targets to ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and scalability for applications running on AWS. The team builds and operates some of the most critical networking infrastructure in the cloud — including Application Load Balancer, Network Load Balancer, and Gateway Load Balancer — serving millions of customers worldwide. We solve complex distributed systems challenges at unprecedented scale, directly impacting how businesses deliver fast, reliable experiences to their end users.

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience

title: Software Development Engineer - II, Elastic Load Balancing (ELB)
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help lead the cloud revolution and build software that thrives at immense scale?
AWS Elastic Load Balancing enables customers to build large scale highly available services. ELB automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets, such as Amazon EC2 instances, containers, IP addresses, and Lambda functions. ELB provides the entry point for building hyper scale, fault tolerant applications. While ELB has seen tremendous growth since launch we are still in the early stages of realizing our full potential.

Why you should join the Amazon ELB team?
We are building and launching new services and features on a regular basis. Application load balancer(ALB), Network load balancer(NLB), Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) and Privatelink are a few examples.

We ship software frequently, get fast feedback from real customers around the globe and see the results of our work come to fruition. The Amazon ELB service is deployed globally to over 30 regions today and is growing at an extremely rapid rate.

There are real-world problems to solve that you won't find ready-made answers for. For example, how do you ensure customers can scale their application quickly to handle traffic spikes and then back down in a matter of minutes? How do you design a load balancing solution that allows customers to quickly and easily achieve the highest levels of fault tolerance using Amazon EC2?

We are now designing and building the next generation of ELB services capable of handling terabytes of data per day and growing from there. This is a unique opportunity to help build large-scale systems from the ground up.
-----------------------------
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain scalable distributed systems that power AWS Elastic Load Balancing services, handling millions of requests per second for customers worldwide
• Write high-quality, maintainable code in Java, C++, or similar languages while participating in code reviews and technical design discussions
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, senior engineers, and operations to deliver new features and improvements that enhance load balancing performance, reliability, and security
• Troubleshoot complex production issues, conduct root cause analysis, and implement solutions that prevent recurrence
• Own end-to-end delivery of medium to large-sized projects, from design through deployment and monitoring
• Contribute to architectural decisions and technical strategy for the team
• Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge sharing
• Monitor system health metrics, participate in on-call rotations, and respond to operational issues to maintain high availability standards
• Drive continuous improvement in development processes, testing practices, and operational excellence
• Stay current with industry trends and AWS technologies to bring innovative solutions to customer problems


About the team
The Elastic Load Balancer (ELB) Workflow team builds the systems that are the brains behind the Control Plane. We manage the massive fleet of instances for all AWS regions ensuring proper execution of the lifecycle of the Load Balancer (LB) nodes. We support Application Load Balancers (ALB) and Classic Load Balancers (CLB). The team owns several systems such as the Workflow Manager and ELB Controller as well as all of the supporting tools and pipelines to ensure the fleet is healthy.

- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

AWS is seeking an experienced Customer Success Specialist for Communication Developer Services (CDS), covering AWS End User Messaging and Amazon Simple Email Service (SES), with a focus on Applied AI. CDS lets customers reach their audiences across every major channel (email, SMS, RCS, push, and WhatsApp) at scale. As communication moves from one-way notifications toward conversational and agentic AI, customer success is where that transformation is realized in production. As a CDS Customer Success Specialist, you will be a strategic advisor who helps customers onboard, ramp, and optimize their messaging and AI-driven communication workloads, leading cross-functional field teams across sales, solutions architecture, partner, and product.

The ideal candidate will have customer success, technical account management, or consulting experience with messaging, communications, or similar SaaS solutions (CPaaS, SMS/messaging, marketing technology, CRM/CDP), and a genuine interest in how AI is reshaping customer engagement. You bring technical depth, comfortable getting hands-on with the services, reasoning about architecture and integration, and guiding customers through configuration and troubleshooting, and you partner with Solutions Architects on the most specialized builds. You are passionate about customer advocacy and bring the voice of the customer into the product development process.

Note on the Applied AI focus: this role centers on leading customer adoption of AI-driven communication and realizing value from it — hands-on AI-practitioner experience (e.g. data scientist or ML engineer) is welcome but not the focus.

Key job responsibilities

Your morning starts in your portfolio's health dashboard: one account's send volume dipped, another stalled in onboarding. You jump on a working session with a Solutions Architect to clear a deliverability blocker and get a customer to production. Midday, you advise a customer's senior stakeholders on their roadmap from one-way messaging toward conversational and agentic AI on CDS channels, then build the account plan with your sales team. title: Sr. Product Designer, Amazon Business UX Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Business is reinventing how organizations of every size—from sole proprietors to global enterprises—discover, buy, and manage what they need to run. We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the end-to-end experience across our core buying surfaces and help shape where business procurement goes in an AI-native world.

You'll work with Product, Engineering, Research, and Conversational Design to turn ambiguous, large-scope problems into experiences that are simple, trustworthy, and measurably better for business customers. This is a senior individual contributor role: you'll set the design direction for complex problems where requirements and technical feasibility aren't yet defined, drive cross-team alignment, and raise the craft bar for the designers around you. The ideal candidate pairs strong product thinking with rigorous craft, is fluent moving between qualitative and quantitative signals, embraces AI tools to iterate prototypes with partners and customers, and leads partners and leaders to critical strategic decisions.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the design of business specific features on top of Amazon.com store capabilities, from framing to detailed design and launch, contributing to define the strategy.
- Partner with Product and Engineering to shape requirements, make high-judgment trade-offs, and ensure designs account for system constraints, edge cases, and scale.
- Synthesize conflicting information from customer anecdotes, heuristics, user tests, surveys, experiments data and product analytics into a perspective, and use it to inform product roadmaps and org-level design strategy.
- Present and defend design recommendations in stakeholder reviews, building consensus among partners who may be diverging.
- Measure the impact of what you ship through product, CX metrics and customer anecdotes, and feed learnings back into the roadmap.
- Define and refine interaction patterns, standards, ways of working and mechanisms, and drive their adoption across teams to reduce duplication and increase delivery speed.
- Contribute to the definition of new ways of working with AI, and be up to date on new standards and paradigms.
- Actively mentor and critique with other designers, helping raise the craft bar across the team.

A day in the life
In a typical day you will be balancing understanding the customer, with hands-on-craft to create proposal or create strategic framings to facilitate decisions with product and business leaders.

In a normal day you will align with your PM and tech lead on priorities and trade-offs for an upcoming milestone, organize your focus time to do deep detailed design work or thinking, review previous research reports and experiment data, meet with partner UX teams to keep adjacent experiences coherent, and present or review concepts in a design critique or cross-functional review to drive a decision. Throughout, you're unblocking engineering, working with our design systems, and coaching a teammate on their work.

About the team
You'll join the Amazon Business UX team in Madrid, a multidisciplinary group of product designers, researchers, and conversational designers shaping Amazon.com experience for business customers.
We work across three main UX studies with design hubs in Seattle and Austin. title: Data Center Controls Tech, Controls Deployment Service
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.

Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.

Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.

Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.

Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.

Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.

Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.

Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.

Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.

Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.

Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.

Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.

Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.

Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.

Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.

Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Technician, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who rely on you to keep Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) healthy and operational. On a given day, you are the boots on the ground solving problems that directly impact data center availability. You might diagnose a controller communication loss, calibrate instruments feeding inaccurate data to operators, or supervise vendors performing quarterly maintenance. For new builds, you perform point to point testing and support commissioning alongside construction teams. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Engineer, Controls Manager, partner teams (Field Engineering, Critical Project Implementation, DCEO), and the vendors you oversee.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Associate’s degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field with 4+ years of relevant industrial Controls or HVAC controls experience, OR 6+ years of relevant industrial or HVAC controls experience in lieu of a degree.
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment in a data center, hospitals, large commercial complex, water, power, oil & gas or similar industries.
- 3+ years of experience working with low voltage controls, wiring, networking signals, electrical and mechanical systems, computers and operating systems.
- Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts and overtime as required.

Preferred qualifications

- Associate's degree in related field
- International Society of Automation (ISA) Certified Controls System Technician (CCST) Level I or higher certification.
- Experience using common communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet, and/or MODBUS).
- 5+ years of experience in controls/automation, construction or related field in a technical environment.
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Experience in data centers or mission critical environment
- Fundamental knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling.
- Prior AWS/Amazon experience
- 4+ Yr. Military Service

You will join our team in helping customers understand how our infrastructure is designed, operated, maintained, and protected in accordance with global regulated industry standards. In this role, you will be responsible for the following activities:
- Dive deep into the Amazon control environment to develop broad domain and technical understanding of our security activities and control implementations to articulate compliance implications to both customers and internal/external audit functions.
- Develop understanding of regulated industry compliance requirements and communicate how we control activities to meet global regulatory obligations.
- Liaise with customers, regulators and auditors, articulate control implementation, and describe considerations for applying security and compliance concepts to monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve the organization by being a trusted advisor, facilitator and creative problem solver.
- Implement continuous improvements to the security organization and the program management process. Share program/project process frameworks, tools, and best practices that can be adopted throughout the organization.
- Apply a working knowledge of global information security regulation and policy to articulate customer and control impact and drive alignment to Amazon controls.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Security
At AWS, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of AWS’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Information Security or other related fields
- Experience in performing and/or participating in IT audits based on ISAE 3401, auditing COBIT, ITIL, IT-Grundschutz and assessments of highly technical cloud-based environments.
- Experience in risk assessment, building programs and strategies up to date on related industry trends
- Experience working in highly regulated industries (e.g. financial services, healthcare, and energy, telecommunications), including direct work with European audits and frameworks such as DORA.

Preferred qualifications

title: Senior Specialist, Program Management, ATS Linehaul Carrier Management
descriptionHtml:
Amazonは「地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業になること」をビジョンに掲げており、日本国内においてもさらなるカスタマーエクスペリエンスの向上のため、最高水準の配送サービスを提供すべく、自社で輸配送ネットワークを構築し、進化させています。

Sr. Specialist, Program Managementは全国の拠点間輸送を担う幹線運送会社（キャリア）およびアマゾン社内関連部署（計画/物流拠点/システム/財務等）と連携し、幹線輸送における様々なプログラムマネジメントを通じて輸送キャパシティの拡大と効率化に取り組みます。
具体的には以下のような業務を遂行していただきます。

■各種プログラムマネジメント
アマゾンの幹線輸送ネットワークは常に進化し続けており、多様な輸送モードによりお客様にご購入いただいた商品をより早く・安全にお届けしています。主力となる大型・中型トラックによる輸送に加えて、小型トラックを活用した輸送・集荷サービス、家具・家電などの大型商品輸送、日用品をいち早くお客様にお届けするための拠点間在庫移動など様々なプログラムが拡大を続けています。本ポジションにおいては、これらのプログラムを社内関連部門と連携して管理・発展させていくことに責任を負います。また、各プログラムの取扱いボリュームや対象エリアの拡大に合わせて、規模・コスト・品質などの観点から最適なキャリアを選定し、安定的に必要なキャパシティを確保し続けるための施策の立案・実行・検証を行います。また、プログラム単位の最適化を追求するだけではなく、それらを横断した輸送キャパシティの相互活用についてもイニシアチブを持って取り組みます。

■テクノロジーを活用した業務プロセス企画・改善
Amazonのビジネスの成長に伴う輸配送ネットワークの拡大・進化のスピードは圧倒的であり、これを支えているのが、システムやデータを活用し最適化したネットワーク設計・需要予測・配送計画の策定や、キャリアへの受発注や業務品質の可視化プロセスです。「より確実に、無駄なく、柔軟に」輸送キャパシティを確保できるよう、キャリア業務や中長期的な市場動向、併走する複数のシステム/プロジェクトへの理解を基に、新規プロジェクト又は既存業務の改善提案をリード又は参画し、関係各所との連携を取りながら戦略を立案・実行します。

■各プログラムにおけるピークキャパシティ確保のための戦術の立案・実行
アマゾンには年に数回大型セールを実施しており、期間中は通常期と比較して取扱いボリュームが大幅に増加します。各プログラムにおいても同様であり、毎年過去最高を更新し続ける取扱いボリュームをカバーするキャパシティをどのように確保するのか、本ポジションでは関連部署と連携してプロキュアメント方法についての戦術立案と実行を担います。また、安全・確実な輸送の実現のためにはキャリアの品質マネジメントが非常に重要であり、ピーク時には多くの新規キャリアが参入するため、事前の各種オペレーションの周知徹底と業務・運行品質の高位平準化にも、アカウントマネジメントチームと連携して取り組みます。

上記の通り、各プログラムやシステム活用において課題を抽出・分析し、柔軟かつデータドリブンな思考に基づいて改善アクションを立案・実行し、リーダーシップを発揮できる人材を募集します。
また、各プログラムやシステム検討などは基本的に英語でのミーティングが中心となるため、ビジネスレベルの英語力（会議でディスカッションできるレベル）があることが望ましいです。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

1.[60%]各種プログラムマネジメント

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:

title: Operations Engineer, Last Mile Engineering Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 5, 2026

Are you energized by solving real-world engineering challenges that directly improve safety, quality, and productivity for customers? As an Operations Engineer at Amazon, you will manage the lifecycle of greenfield and brownfield projects — from initial design through installation and qualification. You will collaborate with cross-functional partners including Engineering, Safety, Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations to deliver solutions on time and within budget. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team that is expanding its project portfolio, where your ability to navigate change, solve problems, and drive results will have a visible impact on how Amazon serves its customers.

Between meetings, you use tools like Smartsheet and Autodesk to update timelines, track milestones, and flag risks before they become blockers.

Our team delivers engineering solutions that help Amazon's operations run safely, efficiently, and at scale. We work across a growing mix of greenfield and brownfield projects, partnering closely with Operations, Safety, and Supply Chain teams to turn customer needs into real, working infrastructure.
