title: Research Scientist, Pricing Science
descriptionHtml:
Pricing is one of the most consequential decisions Amazon makes, and the science behind it needs to be causally rigorous, not just predictive. The P2 Optimization Science team builds the machine learning (ML) systems that power Amazon's pricing decisions at scale: demand lift models, customer lifetime value (LTV) frameworks, and the experimentation infrastructure that validates whether pricing changes actually work.

We're looking for a Research Scientist to own causal inference at the intersection of ML and pricing experimentation. Our team has identified a real gap: the methodological bridge between econometric analysis and production-scale ML pipelines needs a practitioner who lives in both worlds. You'll build conditional average treatment effect (CATE) estimation models, design analysis workflows for pricing experiments, and develop reusable causal ML infrastructure that the broader team — including non-ML scientists — can rely on. If you're a scientist who wants to tackle hard causal identification problems in a high-stakes production environment, and who finds satisfaction in making rigorous methods accessible to a broader team, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, train, evaluate, and deploy end-to-end causal ML pipelines for pricing use cases, including CATE estimation models and heterogeneous treatment effect frameworks.
- Serve as the team's causal ML methodology expert — defining identification strategies, model selection criteria, evaluation standards, and the tradeoffs between econometric and ML approaches to causal estimation.
- Contribute causal analysis methodology to pricing A/B test post-analysis and build reusable tooling that economists and other non-ML scientists can adopt without requiring deep ML expertise.
- Assess emerging causal inference methods (e.g., synthetic difference-in-differences, generalized random forests, causal representation learning) for applicability to Amazon's pricing context, and author internal methodology proposals for adoption.
- Partner with senior economists on identification strategy and causal assumptions, collaborate with software and data engineering partners on production deployment, and align with product managers on experiment design requirements.

A day in the life
Your work directly shapes the prices customers see on hundreds of millions of Amazon products. In a given week you might investigate an optimization anomaly in simulation and trace it to an unmodeled market dynamic, then design an offline evaluation framework to benchmark competing approaches before committing to online testing. You'll collaborate with senior economists on identification strategy for a pricing experiment, present a science proposal for incorporating a new competitiveness signal into an optimization system, or work with the experimentation platform team on randomization design. You'll also have opportunities to write up novel scientific findings for submission to venues such as KDD, NeurIPS, or the ACM Conference on Economics and Computation.

About the team
The P2 Optimization Science team sits at the center of Amazon's pricing decisions. We build the ML systems, causal inference pipelines, and experimentation infrastructure that determine how prices are set across Amazon's global catalog. Our team brings together research scientists, economists, and engineers who collaborate closely to turn rigorous methodology into production-quality systems with measurable business impact. We value scientific rigor, clear communication across disciplines, and a culture where every team member's work is designed to be extensible and useful beyond their own project. If you want your science to directly influence how hundreds of millions of customers experience Amazon, this is the team to join.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of quantitative field research experience
- Experience investigating the feasibility of applying scientific principles and concepts to business problems and products
- Experience analyzing both experimental and observational data sets

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of R, MATLAB, Python or similar scripting language
- Experience with agile development
- Experience building web based dashboards using common frameworks
- In depth familiarity with the literature and practice of operations management, supply chain management, inventory management, revenue management, forecasting, and/or logistics
- Prior well-established recognized academic experience, multiple publications in top-tier academic journals Programming experience using at least one modern programming language such as Python, Java, or C++
- Proficiency in model development, model validation and model implementation for large-scale applications
- Experience with developing prototypes by manipulating and analyzing complex, high-volume, high-dimensionality data from varying sources

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:

This role is ideal for someone with a CTO, CDIO, or senior digital leadership background in the NHS who wants to apply that expertise at national scale — shaping propositions that will transform care delivery across the system.

A day in the life

You'll balance strategic account planning with tactical deal execution — one moment you're working with a Trust's to shape their infrastructure strategy, the next you're navigating a procurement framework. descriptionHtml:
Amazon installs a significant quantity of new buildings every year. The historical model has been to allow each integrator to use their own equipment, controls, subsystems, and methodologies. descriptionHtml:

title: Principal Accounting Manager, Amazon Stores
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Stores business is the heart of how we serve hundreds of millions of customers worldwide — spanning our fulfillment network, transportation and logistics, physical stores, and the capital infrastructure that powers them. Supporting the continued expansion of this business requires individuals with deep accounting experience AND the entrepreneurial aptitude to accelerate decision making and management of the business and its accounting. Also needed is the intellectual capacity to produce innovative ideas/analysis and the willingness to take end-to-end ownership in implementing those decisions.

As the Stores Infrastructure Technical Accounting subject matter expert, you will own the end-to-end accounting for new financing initiatives that support Amazon's worldwide operations and infrastructure expansion. This includes real estate and equipment leasing, fleet and material-handling-equipment (MHE) financing and/or leasing arrangements, build-to-suit and sale-leaseback structures, and other emerging capital programs across the Stores network. You will be surrounded by people that are exceptionally talented, bright, and driven, and believe that world class support is critical to customer and business success. To support this quickly growing business, you must be highly analytical and possess a strong passion for analytics and accountability, setting high standards, and making decisions that are right a lot.

As the Principal Accounting Manager, you will serve as the single-threaded owner of accounting policy, controls, and reporting for the Stores leasing and financing activities — upholding an exceptionally high controllership bar across every transaction, control, and disclosure. Your ability to make a difference and take ownership begins on Day One. You will partner cross-functionally with Finance, Business, Treasury, Tax, Legal, FP&A, and Tech teams to stand up new accounting frameworks, design and strengthen the control environment, drive system implementations, and ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards.

Key job responsibilities
This position will be responsible for:
• Own the end-to-end accounting lifecycle for Stores CapEx, infrastructure, and leasing financing transactions.
• Assess the accounting for new business events, transactions, and structures across the relevant technical literature including ASC 842 (Leases), ASC 815 (Derivatives and Hedging), and ASC 360 (Assets Held for Sale) and determine the appropriate treatment.
• Lead the implementation of accounting structures for new and evolving lease structures across the Stores network (real estate, fleet, and equipment).
• Drive the design and execution of accounting processes in Amazon systems to support lease and financing origination, modification, and termination workflows.
• Develop and maintain lease and financing accounting models, including present value calculations, classification assessments, and ongoing measurement under ASC 842.
• Partner with Treasury, Tax, Legal, FP&A, Finance, Business, and Tech teams to evaluate new financing structures and provide accounting guidance on proposed transactions.
• Set and enforce a high controllership bar: design, implement, and maintain SOX-compliant internal controls over leasing and financing processes, including journal entries, reconciliations, and disclosures, with full audit-readiness.
• Prepare and review technical accounting memos for complex lease/financing arrangements, including sale-leaseback, variable lease payments, embedded lease assessments, embedded derivatives, and held-for-sale conclusions.
• Own monthly close activities for the leasing and financing portfolio, including journal entries, flux analysis, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial statement disclosures.
• Lead cross-functional projects to stand up new leasing and financing programs, coordinating requirements across accounting, systems, operations, and business teams.
• Identify and drive process improvement and automation opportunities to scale leasing and financing operations and enhance the control environment.

Basic qualifications

- 12+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Experience in a leadership position managing finance, accounting and operational processes

title: BIE II, Tax
descriptionHtml:
Global Tax Data (GTD) organization provides data management services and supports program and product initiatives that improve tax data integrity across Amazon's global indirect tax compliance operations. GTD ensures timely, accurate data is available for tax compliance reporting and audit readiness, and our teams manage the tax data infrastructure, pipelines, reconciliation tools, and operational reporting that compliance teams rely on worldwide.

As a Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE) II in GTD, you'll build gold-standard analytics datasets and data mart/warehouses while driving the data analysis, reconciliation operations, root-cause investigations, and process improvements that directly support Amazon's monthly tax compliance cycles. You'll partner cross-functionally with your customers in tax compliance and accounting, and with stakeholders across finance technology, to make sure the data behind every filing is complete, accurate, and delivered on time. You'll also work closely with Data Engineering, Software Engineering, and Solutions Architects.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys digging into large datasets — spotting patterns, explaining the story behind the variances, and driving issues to resolution independently.

You'll thrive here if you bring strong analytical skills, the ability (or a genuine eagerness to build it) to work with large-scale data, and the business judgment to translate tax and accounting context into the right system configurations.

Key job responsibilities
• Build and own the Gold standard data mart/warehouse for business reporting and analysys
• Perform hands-on reconciliation and detailed analysis of large financial datasets each month, investigating and resolving discrepancies across source systems, tax reporting warehouses, and the general ledger.
• Troubleshoot data quality issues, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions with upstream and downstream teams.
• Partner with compliance and customer teams to understand reporting requirements and translate business objectives into clear data specifications and technical development requirements.
• Develop and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and metrics that give visibility into reconciliation health and data readiness.
• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, controllership, and data quality — automating manual processes, reducing cycle time, and coaching customer teams on how to use the reporting and functionality you build.
• Own and manage SIM tickets and intake workflows, ensuring timely response and resolution for internal and external stakeholders.
• Support audit data requests by extracting, validating, and delivering data packages to auditors and tax authorities.
• Document standard operating procedures, runbooks, and process flows for recurring operational activities.
• Build strong relationships with key technology providers and technical teams across Amazon, and clearly explain financial and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Contribute to Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (MBRs/QBRs) and operational readiness activities.

About the team
We are a fast-growing team supporting the Corporate Tax function. We seek candidates who are eager and able to learn new content quickly, who are willing to venture into unfamiliar territory, and who bring ironclad judgment and integrity when handling confidential information.




A day in the life
Work closely with Tech partners, non-tech customer and team to deliver the required solution.

- Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools

- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience with SQL

descriptionHtml:

At Amazon Transportation, we are building a world-class last mile operation, significantly complimented by our brand new service, which works directly with independent contractors – called delivery partners – to make deliveries to our customers. With this new last mile delivery service (Amazon Flex), individuals can now be their own boss delivering Amazon packages. It is powered by a mobile app that works in concert with our advanced logistics systems that allows delivery partners to on board, schedule delivery times, guide them through their deliveries with in-app mapping and navigation, and more. The approach and technology are nothing short of disruptive, and promise to challenge traditional approaches, and change the way the industry operates.

title: Supply Chain Management, SSD
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and execution-focused L3 Associate to own and drive end-to-end launch management and supply chain readiness across key workstreams, including forecasting, licensing, CAPS deployment, and operational planning. The role will be responsible for coordinating launch activities from initial planning through execution and post-launch stabilization, ensuring alignment across business, supply chain, planning, licensing, and operations teams.

The associate will play a critical role in ensuring launch readiness by driving demand forecasting inputs, tracking supply and inventory requirements, coordinating licensing activities and approvals, and managing CAPS deployment in line with defined timelines and business requirements. This includes maintaining accurate launch plans, monitoring critical milestones and dependencies, identifying potential supply or execution risks, and proactively driving resolutions to avoid launch delays or operational disruptions.

The role requires strong ownership of multiple parallel workstreams, effective stakeholder management, and the ability to translate business requirements into actionable execution plans. The associate will be expected to establish robust tracking mechanisms, provide timely visibility into launch progress and risks, and ensure that all launch-related activities are completed within agreed timelines. Additionally, the role will focus on improving process adherence, strengthening cross-functional coordination, and identifying opportunities to enhance forecasting accuracy, deployment efficiency, and overall supply chain readiness.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, managing competing priorities, and driving closure through structured planning, data-driven decision-making, and proactive follow-through. The ultimate objective is to ensure seamless launch execution, accurate forecasting, timely licensing readiness, successful CAPS deployment, and uninterrupted supply chain operations.

Key job responsibilities
Launch Management: Own end-to-end launch planning, readiness tracking, execution, and post-launch stabilization.
CAPS Deployment: Drive CAPS deployment across applicable supply chain operations, ensuring adherence to deployment plans, timelines, and defined processes.
Cross-functional Coordination: Partner with supply chain, operations, planning, technology, and other relevant teams to align on launch requirements and deployment readiness.
Milestone Tracking: Maintain launch trackers, deployment schedules, action logs, and status reports to ensure timely execution.
Risk and Issue Management: Identify potential risks, deployment blockers, and dependencies; drive timely resolution and escalate critical issues as required.
Operational Readiness: Validate process readiness, resource availability, system/process dependencies, and stakeholder alignment before launch.
Performance Monitoring: Track key operational metrics, deployment progress, and launch performance to identify gaps and drive corrective actions.
Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to standardize launch processes, improve deployment efficiency, and strengthen execution mechanisms.
Documentation and Reporting: Maintain deployment documentation, SOPs, launch checklists, and regular progress updates for stakeholders.

- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications

- Ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, and dependencies simultaneously.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities.
- Proficiency in Excel and reporting tools; experience with dashboards or project tracking tools is preferred.

title: Software Development Engineer, Autonomous Fleet Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics Autonomous Fleet Services (AFS) is building the intelligence that turns autonomous robots into fleets that work together. Our software orchestrates thousands of robots across some of the most complex logistics operations in the world, so that every robot, every task, and every minute counts. We are growing and seek a talented, enthusiastic, and motivated Software Development Engineer to help build our Fleet Management system.

The Fleet Management team builds the brain of the fleet: the system that sees everything happening on the floor, decides what every robot does next, and keeps operations running as conditions change around it. As an SDE on this team, you will own significant components of that system, from the services that turn arriving work into tasks to the logic that assigns and re-assigns those tasks as robots, floor space and deadlines shift. You will design and build features end to end, take them through code review and launch, and carry them in production once they are live. You will contribute to design reviews for systems other teams depend on, and grow into the calls that decide how the fleet behaves under load and under failure. The systems you help build will scale to thousands of robots working safely and efficiently alongside people, and grow as Amazon's robotics footprint expands across the globe.

The successful candidate is a hands-on builder with solid experience designing, building and operating scalable, highly available distributed systems in production. You are comfortable with ambiguity: taking a problem stated in terms of floor outcomes, asking the questions that sharpen it, and shipping incrementally without disrupting live operations. You reason from measured behavior rather than intuition, and you expect to be held to what the data says. Experience in areas such as distributed systems, task allocation and scheduling, resource management, event-driven architectures, and operating production services is desired. Familiarity with robotics, logistics, or warehouse automation is a plus.

Key job responsibilities
• Architect, design, and implement robotic applications and infrastructure.
• Influence the team's strategy and contribute to long-term vision and roadmap.
• Work with stakeholders across the organization to iterate on design and implementation.
• Maintain high standards by participating in reviews, designing for fault tolerance and operational excellence, and creating mechanisms for continuous improvement.
• Prototype and test concepts or features, both through simulation and emulators and with live robotic equipment
• Work directly with customers and partners to test prototypes and incorporate feedback
• Mentor other engineers on the team.

title: Sr. Associate - Quality Analyst, Global Solutions & Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Chemical Safety Compliance, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 1+ years of logistics, transportation, supply chain, import/export operations, or data entry/data administration experience
- Knowledge of Excel at a basic level (e.g., UX navigation, math & logical functions, lookup functions, etc.)
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis

Preferred qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Bachelor's degree in logistics, transporation, supply chain, or business
- Licensed customs broker
- Experience in international logistics, cross-border transportation and supply chain, or U.S. Customs rules and regulations
- Experience in customs

title: Technik BHP
descriptionHtml:

Rozumiejąc, jak działa każde zadanie i każda maszyna, będziesz w stanie znaleźć najlepszy sposób na zapewnienie bezpieczeństwa procesów. Będziesz również jedną z osób wdrażających zmiany w zakresie bezpieczeństwa, co oznacza, że będziesz ściśle współpracować z wieloma osobami. title: EU Regulatory Airspace Specialist, Drone Delivery, EU/UK Regulatory Affairs Prime Air
descriptionHtml:
Prime Air is bringing drone delivery to Europe. Every site we open needs safe, approved access to airspace, and today that is the single largest bottleneck between us and launch. You will own it.
You will lead airspace integration for our European operations: the airspace case inside each Operational Authorisation, national procedures, Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) approvals, U-Space coordination, and the relationships with air navigation service providers that make it work. You will also lead our Detect-and-Avoid validation work with national authorities, turning a novel technology into something a regulator can accept. Success is airspace approved on time for every site on our launch plan, and a repeatable method that gets faster with each one.

Key job responsibilities
Own airspace assessment tasks and integration work in the EU: e.g. BVLOS flight authorisation, U-Space coordination, national airspace procedures, geographical zone screening for each candidate site
Deliver the airspace components of EU site approvals, working with the Head of Regulatory Approvals who owns the overall Operational Authorisation.
Own the air risk assessment within each SORA application: e.g. air risk class determination, strategic and tactical mitigations, and the DAA evidence that supports them, delivered to the EU Head of Regulatory Approvals for integration into the safety case.
Lead engagement with Air Navigation Service Providers and U-Space service providers, and manage airspace and ANSP consultants during application peaks.
Keep airspace positions consistent across jurisdictions, working with the wider Regulatory Affairs team.
Build reusable airspace templates and evidence packs so each new site is faster than the last.

A day in the life
You will split your time between authority and ANSP engagement, building the airspace case for the next site, and working with our engineering and safety teams to turn technical capability into regulatory evidence. You will travel to candidate sites and authority meetings across the EU.

About the team
How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and—most importantly—safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers and are excited for what's to come.
If you are seeking an iterative environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real world delivery challenges, and provide benefits to customers, Amazon is the place for you.
Check out more information about Prime Air on the About Amazon blog (https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/transportation/amazon-prime-air-delivery-drone-reveal-photos).

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related technical field
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management
- Aviation airspace or air traffic management background, with UAS or U-Space integration experience in an EU Member State.
- Working knowledge of the EU U-Space regulation (2021/664) and national airspace procedures in one or more Member States.
- Familiarity with Detect-and-Avoid concepts, the Specific Operations Risk Assessment (SORA) methodology and airspace risk assessment.
- Proven stakeholder engagement with EU National Aviation Authorities and Air Navigation Service Providers.

Preferred qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience applying SORA end to end, including SAIL determination, Operational Safety Objectives and ground and air risk mitigation.
- Experience engaging multiple national aviation authorities simultaneously.
- Experience securing airspace access or drone corridor approvals with an ANSP.
- Engineering or operations experience in drone operations.

title: Data Center Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to train and onboard new team members

Physical requirements:

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:
-Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
-Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
-Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of computer/server hardware troubleshooting or related IT experience
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Work a flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of network design, protocols and Layer 1/2 troubleshooting
- Associate's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering), or experience in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering)
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system

title: Data Center Mechanical Infrastructure Engineer, JAN Field Engineering

Amazon is looking for a Data Center Infrastructure Engineer to help design, develop, deploy, and maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our global data center fleet running. In this role, you will work on mechanical and electrical systems that directly impact the availability, efficiency, and reliability of our infrastructure. You will collaborate with engineers and cross-functional partners to solve real technical challenges, propose improvements, and deliver solutions that serve millions of customers worldwide. If you are a curious, adaptable problem-solver who thrives in a hands-on engineering environment, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain data center infrastructure components, applying engineering best practices to ensure efficiency, security, and availability of physical resources such as power, cooling, and server rack systems.

- Develop and clearly document infrastructure solutions, including engineering models and technical drawings, so that current and future team members understand design intent and system dependencies.

A day in the life

Much of your time will be spent in the field inspecting mechanical and electrical systems, gathering data, and validating that installations meet design specifications. About the team
Our team is focused on ensuring that Amazon's data center infrastructure is reliable, efficient, and ready to meet growing customer demand. We work at the intersection of mechanical engineering, data center design, and operational excellence, tackling challenges that range from component-level improvements to facility-wide upgrades. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a willingness to take on problems end to end. If you are excited about building infrastructure that supports innovation at global scale, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
- Experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical facilities, especially data centers

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
- Knowledge of commercial or industrial power systems or mechanical systems
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production

title: Data Center Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.
Data Center Technician position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

• Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching

• Work in an industrial environment

• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Our Data Center Technician professionals, who have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while they:

descriptionHtml:
The North American Network Design, Planning, & Engineering (NDPE) Containerization Strategy & Engineering (CS&E) team aims to develop novel containerization strategies and network-level sortation capabilities to increase capacity, reduce cost via touches reduction, and maximize delivery speeds through cycle time optimization. The CS&E team partners with stakeholders across business-unit specific engineering teams, Amazon Robotics, WWDE, and many others in order to align a vision for the future state of pre-sortation and containerization throughout the multi-fulfillment delivery network (MFN).

The Senior Supply Chain Manager will own a program or series of programs aimed at transforming the way 1P packages and containers are handled throughout our delivery network. The successful SCM will have experience managing highly visible and cross functional initiatives, driving strategic alignment across a diverse group of stakeholders and motivations, and a high drive towards identifying E2E wins and analyzing associated business impacts to present streamlined business cases for investment.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will own the strategy and design of a large-scale transportation and sortation network. You'll turn complex data into decisions that lower cost and speed up delivery for customers.

- Lead the design and rollout of new outbound network models, using data to show their cost and speed advantage over the current network.
- Build and own profitability models that show which sortation capacity earns its cost across regions and business lines. Use the results to shape facility design standards.

- Develop capital plans and business cases for new and expanded sites, and defend them with finance and operations leaders.
- Design and run pilots that test new dispatch strategies, then scale what works.

- Define, track and report core metrics, including transportation cost per package and network performance against plan.

- Partner with data scientists, engineers, finance and field operations to turn models into plans people can carry out.

- Write clear recommendations and present them to senior leadership.
- Mentor teammates and raise the bar on analytical rigor and modeling standards.

About the team
The GTS Network Design, Planning, & Engineering team focuses on both near term and long term 1P requirements that enable capacity growth, cost reduction, faster speed, better quality and greater sustainability in our transportation network. We prioritize solutions that deliver against strategic corporate transportation related goals, with a focus on projects that support achieving our speed, cost, and reliability objectives. While we have specific targets to deliver, our team operates with limited boundaries that requires us to lead large cross organizational initiatives, and identify, pilot, and deploy new opportunities that deliver results. We are a collection of engineers, PMs, BIEs/DSs, and supply chain leaders that use our technical and operational expertise to provide direction for the future requirements of the transportation network to continuously deliver on behalf of our customers.

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- 5+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

title: Regional Chief Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

As the Data Center Chief Engineer (CE), you will be responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. You will serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager and interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third party vendors. Being the singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center, you will support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

As the Chief Engineer you will manage small-to-medium impacting projects from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. Creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

One of the best parts to this role is that you will direct, train and support Engineering Operation Technicians in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.


Key job responsibilities
- Setting and maintaining the highest standards for safety and actively promoting a world-class safety culture in all aspects of operational procedure
- Driving continuous improvement efforts on infrastructure through standardization of procedures and policies, while delivering performance against agreed metrics
- Working closely with the Operations Principal Engineer, site Chief Engineers and broader operations teams to streamline maintenance procedures, and implement standardized risk assessment protocols.
- Enabling the operations organisation to delivering 100% uptime on all customer supporting infrastructure
- Training and mentoring technical operations staff members on the execution of all corrective and preventative maintenance activities on all mission-critical infrastructure
- Collaborating effectively with 3rd party providers to deliver operational excellence for all AWS customers
- Innovation and delivery of a portfolio of strategic projects on critical infrastructure to ensure class-leading performance
- The successful delivery of build-out and retrofit of facility infrastructure in existing and new regional locations through a deep technical review and execution of construction & commissioning activities by contracted providers
- Ensuring organizational capability to react & respond appropriately to any potential customer impacting event on any component of electrical or mechanical infrastructure.
- Elevating capabilities of site chief engineers and EOT’s, establish training requirements, coordinate operational readiness testing (LLT, MOT, CCT), LSE/CSE drill & CST programs.


A day in the life
The regional chief will act as a technical advisor for the cluster ops leader. They will be responsible for alignment between clusters in ATL. They'll act as a SME in Construction and Availability programs within the cluster.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
- 10+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment, or 10+ years of relevant discipline work experience
- Experience with cross functional project or program delivery
- Experience managing and negotiating contracts and vendor relationships
- Regional data center engineering operations experience

Preferred qualifications

- operating engineering license such as DC II, DC III, or equivalent
- Stationary Engineering or Building Engineering License
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- Electrical or mechanical Journeyman License, CFC license, NFPA 70E.

Reporting directly into the Head of Movies Digital Marketing for Amazon MGM Studios, you will act as a collaborative stakeholder across marketing globally, ensuring the highest standards for consistency and quality are maintained to drive moviegoers to theaters on theatrical films and drive viewership and attract new customers to Prime Video on streaming originals. The optimal candidate for this role will have experience in working on digital marketing campaigns as well as building deep partnerships with creative agencies. You are able to fluidly shift from analytical discussions to strategy to operational to creative to logistics. You would serve as one of the key internal points of contact for digital marketing campaigns globally, so strategic judgment, creative acumen, logistical excellence, awareness of industry trends and ability to think big must be robust. Finally, the ideal candidate must thrive operating in a startup environment, where leaders are owners, wear multiple hats, and effortlessly think and act both strategically and tactically - from the development of broad strategic ideas to execution.

Key job responsibilities
Social Vision & Leadership
- Be a part of the team creating digital marketing campaigns for their assigned Theatrical and Streaming Amazon MGM Studios films.
- Guide the creation of world-class, break-through digital and social marketing strategies that support and reinforces Amazon MGM Studios in the film marketplace, in keeping with the business and marketing strategy for the brand.
- Develop inventive, strategic influencer marketing campaigns that inspire our customers while driving awareness and viewership.
- Contribute strong strategic thinking to ideate and develop innovative, effective, and award-winning digital marketing experiences.
- Raise the bar on social marketing globally. Work with the international teams for implementing this vision and strategy across all territories.
- Embrace performance data, and refine future digital marketing strategies based on these insights.
- Contribute to campaign reviews and presentations, while successfully presenting social marketing concepts and narratives for senior management.
- Have a strong point of view and vision along with a clear, concise ability to provide strategic and creative direction to internal and external partners.
- Think big. Drive new ideas that lead to innovative social marketing programs and events to support launches.
- Proactively contribute to create policies, procedures, best practices and formalize mechanisms that impact the broader department.

Business Acumen
- Facilitate the digital campaign management, producing work cost effectively and on schedule.
